review_text: BEST. MOISTURIZER. EVER.I have been using Clinique’s Gel moisturizer for almost 17 years now (started using it when I was in highschool)! And throughout my skin journey I’ve tried many other brands (both affordable ones to the crazy expensive ones), and honestly, I always go back to this moisturizer. We’ve been through many stages of my life together (puberty, young adult, and soon hitting my 30’s), and I don’t think any other product will ever compare to this. I have very oily skin (especially around my T-zone), and the rest of my face can get pretty dry when the Canadian winters come around. This moisturizer not only moisturizes well, but it gets soaked up quickly into my skin without leaving any discomfort or residue. For the winters, simply apply a bit more layers than usual and it will again soak up nicely with no added residue. Because of this gel, my skin became less oily and my pores shrank noticeably. Added bonus is that it is extremely affordable for the quality you get.I’m definitely growing old with this moisturizer and will introduce this to my unborn children one day.

review_text: This gel absorbs fast and is very lightweight, but very moisturizing. I used to use this a couple years ago but stopped, as I figured that if my skin got slightly oily, I didn’t need moisturizer. This spring my skin got sooo dry but it was still greasy at the same time. I couldn’t figure out what was going on until I went and got a facial and the woman told me that I was overdrying my skin with acne products, when I really didn’t have acne! Long story short, I began to use an oil they recommended at night and this in the mornings! It spreads in so easily, it feels moisturizing yet light, and the best part, my skin isn’t greasy anymore! My skin was creating more and more oil to compensate and I couldn’t be happier with the result I have received with this product! Highly recommend! Perfect for normal to oily skin!!!! If you can’t afford the full size, buy the travel size, because it will last a long time and it is totally worth it!

review_text: As someone who has mostly normal skin that sometimes leans dry I picked this up on a whim for my mother who frequently complains at the greasiness of most moisturizers, while she has yet to form an opinion on it I’ve found it to be really nice for the days you feel like you don’t need moisturizer or even during summer when your skin may not be as vulnerable to dryness.It’s not the best moisturizer for dryness but in all fairness it doesn’t claim to be, my expectations were unrealistic in that regard.A minor complaint with the bottle design not exclusive to the gel, I’d like to be able to take the moisturizer cleanly from the pump instead of having the eventual long term build up of dried product around the opening but the muzzle is very short and that is an unfortunate inevitability.I do recommend trying it if only the small sized tube if your skin leans from combination to oily as I believe it will work really well for you.

review_text: Clinique’s Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel was suggested for one of our teens who has slightly oily skin. From my normal skin point of view, it actually felt slightly tightening in a good way. My teen felt this absorbed nicely and quickly, leaving skin looking refreshed. This seems to be an excellent gel moisturizer.

It saves me having to have two different moisturizers for AM & PM, which I love, and I think this is a great value for the money anyway.

review_text: okay i bought this at the end of summer, i think, and i really liked it at first. it absorbed really fast and it gave my skin a nice glow. but it is now winter and i can not use it. it does not moisturize as well as i would like it to. though it may be my skin’s fault. my skin is crazy and in the summer it’s super oily and in the winter it’s super dry. if your skin is oily all year round (unlike mine) i recommend this product. however if it is combination or dry go with the lotion instead of the gel. as i mentioned earlier i bought this around summer and i was in the store trying to find a difference between the lotion and gel. i had no make up and and it was a fairly clean face (i had got out of the shower about an hour before i got to the mall and i do wash my face in the shower, yes i know i ramble a lot. anyway) and i put the lotion on one side of my face and the gel on the other side i did like the lotion more than the gel because it was moisturizing and it wasn’t greasy and didn’t make me look greasy or feel greasy. but i bought the gel instead because everyone was like “ooo you’re gonna look like a mcdonalds burger in a couple hours. you best buy the one for oily skin“ and im just like “okay, whatever“ it was only a few dollars difference so i bought this one instead. looking back i do wish i bought the other one but this one is a great summer moisturizer for super oily skin

review_text: This is indeed a good product but I have noticed no dramatic change in my skin. Generally I like to read hundreds of reviews before spending my hard end money over products andt I knew that it wouldn’t bring any significant change in my skin. Still I like it. now the question is why? I am 22 years old having oily skin with some mild acne and I desperately searched for a moisturiser which is oil free,light weight and wont cause me to breakout.And it’s almost impossible to find a oil free moisturiser in drugstore which can treat somewhat problematic skins like me Then I came to know about this product and wanted to g.ive it a try. review_text: I. Absolutely. LOVE. This. Moisturizer! This is a great daily moisturizer even for my normally oily skin. I use this after washing my face and my skin literally drinks in this moisturizer.This is considered a gel but it really feels like a moisturizer without the oiliness. It’s lightweight and it doesn’t leave your face hard, frozen, or sticky like common facial gels can do. Not only that, but after applying it my skin feels so smooth and soft. Another plus? No breakouts from this one!I love that for once, you actually get what you pay for in reference to size and quantity of product. I’ve had my current 4.2 oz bottle for over a month and it’s not even near half gone with at least twice daily use.The only things that could make this product better is if it contained anti-aging/preventive properties (it’s never too early to start!), if it was all natural, if it had oil-controlling properties, and most importantly if it had SPF. I know Peter Roth and Bare Escentuals sell finishing powder with SPF so I’m interested in using that over my moisturizer.I consider this a daily moisturizer and in that it’s great. If there was a time that my skin was intensely dry I would probably use this in combination with a richer moisturizer that’s specifically targeted for extremely dry skin. But as a daily item, I highly recommend this product.

review_text: These days, effective skin creams are always SO expensive! But this one is very reasonably priced and it’s most effective. It’s lightweight and absorbs into your skin quickly and begins to work immediately. It works well overnight. but it’s so fast acting that if I wake up with a dry or peeling spot in the morning I can use it then and my makeup will still look nice over it. This cream is gentle for sensitive spots, combats redness and always provides dry spots with the moisture they need. The only thing I don’t like about this cream is the smell: I think it has an unpleasant sort of medicine-y smell to it. But that’s a minor fault if what you want is a soothing, effective moisture cream. The reasonable price makes this cream a terrific bargain--it’s a lot of product for $28. So if you want results and you’re on a budget, you can’t beat it. HIGHLY recommended!

review_text: I received a generous sample of this with my last Sephora order. I selected the sample after reading so many great reviews about Ultra Repair Cream. But after using the entire sample, I really don’t know what all the hype is about.I agree that the cream is super-emollient and non-greasy. And it’s nice that it contains Colloidal Oatmeal and antioxidants, but I think there are lots of good creams and lotions out there that are just as good and less expensive.The reason I won’t be purchasing this cream is the smell. I’m normally not very picky or bothered by scented products, but this lotion has a strong medicinal smell that faded a little with time, but left this really weird medicinal smell on my skin that I just couldn’t tolerate. When I say “weird medicinal smell“ I mean old-lady perfume mixed with Bengay - it’s that strange and strong.Since there are so many creams out there that are completely unscented, and have some of the same qualities, I won’t be purchasing this cream or recommending it to anyone.

review_text: I had about 10 samples of these from various sephora online shopping sprees and never gave them a chance...what a mistake! After my usual lightweight moisturizers failed to deliver adequate moisture, I broke open one of the samples and WOW!First of all, this has been the only thing to simultaneously clear up the rough flaky patches, provide a smoother base before primer/foundation/etc, and reduce redness and irritation from healing acne. I really thought I was doomed to having horrible combination skin, but this cream saved me! It’s completely face-friendly and does double duty moisturizing my hands. I can’t wait to buy the giant tub of it!

review_text: I was really excited to try this product and with all of the rave reviews, I expected to love it in my dry climate and purchased the largest size. It was nice on my hands but nothing special. When I tried it on my face last night, I immediately felt a light burning sensation. This was odd for 2 reasons: first, this has never happened to me with any moisturizer before and second, this is specifically a “healing” cream. It turns out that the last ingredient, eucalyptus leaf extract, can cause sensitivity in some people and I just happen to be one of them. However, it promotes good oil production so if you have truly dry skin and don’t have a sensitivity to eucalyptus, this could be for you!

review_text: This product saved my skin! I have acne prone, dry skin that flares up due to hormones or stress. My particular problem areas are my chin and my lips. In particular, I had one horrible dry patch that just wouldn’t go away. That patch of skin was dry and flaky and caused my skin to overproduce oils in that area to compensate. These oils then caused bright red, painful, bits of acne to appear around my lips. I would use my strong acne cream on the acne, and it would work to get rid of them, but it made my dry patches worse. My makeup would go on patchy, I couldn’t color correct the area enough, and it affected how my red lipstick would look. It was a vicious cycle!I was in need of a good moisturizer and fast before winter came. I did some research and stumbled upon this holy grail!Within days, my dry, flaky patches of skin around my lips have gone away, and so has the acne in that area. My acne in general around my face has gone down because the dryness has decreased. My skin feel so much happier than it used to!I enjoy the thick, whipped texture of this product and it absorbs fast into my skin. You don’t need a lot either! I’ve been using this product for a few months now every day and night, and I’ve only used a little under 1/4th of the jar. The scent is really pleasant and light, too. For application, I use a little dollop on each section of my face; forehead, right cheek, left cheek, chin, and nose if it is needed.I fully intend on being a continuous consumer of this product and purchasing the travel container, too. All in all, I highly recommend!

review_text: I have always had oily skin in the summer and dry in the winter but this winter has been by far the worst. I had dry, flaky patches everywhere, all I had to do was scratch my skin and it would flake. I’m also in the 2nd trimester of my first pregnancy which seems to have brought about new skin issues. I had been using my trusty drugstore cleanser and moisturizer and found that I kept having to put something else on to quench the dry spots. Nothing in my closet full of skincare products worked, I even used Vaseline Intensive Care for Face and nothing. I almost went and bought Hope in a Jar but found this to be highly rated for a lot less $. It has worked absolute wonders on my skin in 3 days of use. Most of my dry patches are completely gone and my face feels so smooth and protected. I like that it has natural ingredients and no sickening fragrance. If you are suffering like I was, this is a must have!

review_text: After developing what turned out to be rosascea, I was at a loss as to what to use for my skin care regimen since everything seemed to make my skin worse. My face was dry, red, blotchy reactive and flaky. I’ve used the Ultra Repair Cream for 2 months now and I LOVE IT. Within a half hour of application my skin is moisturized (but not shiny), calmed and the redness is almost completely eliminated. That tight, itchy, awful, dry feeling is immediately relieved. The jar is huge, and it can be used anywhere on the body. I use it right after shaving and I never get razor burn anymore. I’ve also tried it on my feet too, and it works really well. It has a subtle calming effect and is not at all greasy. I’ve not had any problem with it ballling up or pilling under primer or foundation. You absolutely cannot beat the price. I will definitely be buying this again!

Now my skin is not scaly and after getting used to the thick cream of CeraVe I have come to appreciate and love the texture of a thick cream. review_text: I got recommended this cream by one of the workers when I asked for a moisturizer for super sensitive and dry skin. I bought the small $10 size to try it out. It’s a very thick cream but I also noticed that it dries matte(?). Nothing wrong with that. Just something I noticed. Before I started using the product, my skin was pretty clear but had dry patches which I wanted to get rid of. And literally after two nights of using this cream they were gone! I was really happy. But something unfortunate also started to occur. After a week I was waking up with EXTREMELY oily skin which I never used to have. I couldn’t even get rid of the oil with blotting sheets and powder. Then my forehead, cheekbones, temples and chin started to breakout (broken heart emoji). My skin at the moment is the worst it’s been in a couple months. I’m so upset because I know I can’t use the product anymore if I was my skin to clear back up. The product isn’t bad at ALL. It worked amazing for the dryness of my skin but unfortunately I have to stop using it as it definitely caused my skin to break out. But just because this happened to me does not mean it will happen to you. Remember we all have different skin types :).

review_text: I have very few products that I cannot live without. I love beauty products, but most of them are just for fun. You need staples. Things that are multi-taskers. It is the best if you are sensitive, itchy, dry, peeling, skin conditions such as eczema. Just go for it, buy the big size. You will be glad you have it. review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! It is great for almost every skin type, and age group. It is hydrating but not greasy or watery. If you are oily DO NOT BE SCARED  of the words “intense hydration“ it won’t break you out or make you too oily, and if you are dry it still provides enough daily hydration. I used to have a very complicated skin care routine filled with oils and serums and scrubs for my oily skin. Once I committed to using this as my only moisturizer I saw a huge change. Now this is part of a two or three step skin care routine I do every day which is a big change from my previous seven/eight steps. There is no secret to this product, no special protein from the sea or water gathered from the purest cloud or something, it is just simple plain ingredients. If you don’t like the pot they also sell it in a squeezy tube. As moisturizers go, this is really reasonably priced! The pot or tube lasts forever so the cost per use is brought down to pennies.  If you are even mildly considered it, regardless of age or skin type I would definitely recommend giving it a try. TL/DR 10/10 would recommend to ANYONE

review_text: I am a very impatient person and despite knowing that doing a patch test with a new product is necessary, I will skip it if it seems normal. (Don’t make the same mistakes that I do, please.) So, I tried a new mask and, to make a long story short, the tops of my cheeks were warm, red, dry, and obviously chemically burned. I typically only use gel-cream moisturizers but I knew I needed something more nourishing and gentle than my usuals so I went through my skincare drawer and found this gem that I’d been sent in a subscription box some time before. I washed my face with a gentle cleanser and slathered this on before bed. I woke up and my face looked so hydrated (and maybe slightly oily because that’s my skin type) and didn’t feel nearly as bad as it had the night before. I did the same routine, morning and night, for the next two days and I haven’t stopped using it since. If I’m going to wear makeup, I’ll usually use a lighter moisturizer in the morning and this at night because it is heavier and I naturally have oily skin! I highly recommend this for a gentle, very hydrating moisturizer.

review_text: I have naturally oily skin, large pores and I’m beginning to see fine lines and age-related symptoms in my skin. I’ve incorporated the moisturizing bomb and age knockdown bomb duo as part of my daily evening routine for 2 weeks. First I use a cleanser, then apply toner, then the youth creator age knockdown bomb, then the True Cream Moisturizing Bomb all over my face and neck. I’ve noticed my skin is more smooth and feels more moisturized than before. Pores are the same size, have not increased or decreased. I believe with long term use my skin will look and feel younger and more plump. A little goes a long way, coverage is great and it is absorbed quickly.

review_text: This stuff is a game changer. I’ve always had pretty good skin. When I moved to Portland OR, my skin freaked out. I was breaking out all the time, had dry patches on my face, etc. For a year I experimented with all sorts of heavy-duty moisturizers, but I couldn’t seem to moisturize my face enough. I always had combination skin, so this was new to me. When I was sent the Moisturizing Bomb in a Sephora Play box, I was skeptical, but I gave it a shot. I am so glad I did! It’s such a great formula. It doesn’t have a scent, it’s thick going on but doesn’t leave grease behind, and it does actually work. I use this combined with the Hungarian Water Essence once per day and my skin is now so glowy and healthy. I haven’t had any major breakouts for a long time. I highly recommend this moisturizer for anyone, really, but especially people with dry skin.I knocked a star off because the packing makes it look like you get more than you too. There’s a lot of unnecessary plastic, which is frustrating and the cost is pretty high for what you get.

review_text: This moisturizer smells so good and feels nice with its soft whipped texture. It’s good for acne prone skin and dry skin too, though I occasionally had to reapply on really cold/dry days. My biggest issue is that the jar looks much larger than what it actually holds — a measly 50 ml, which makes this product quite expensive for something that doesn’t do too much. The moisturizer sits in a small cove within and doesn’t fill up the entire jar, which quite honestly makes me feel as though I’ve been played, not to mention it’s wasteful and inefficient. Won’t be repurchasing.

It’s not the most moisturizing, it’s not the most luxe, I don’t love the packaging (huge package that’s deceptive about the amount inside; it’s also not super sanitary b/c it’s in a tub), it’s unfortunately not a “clean” brand but it smells lovely, works well and keeps me free of pimps. It’s my ride or die.

review_text: I got a sample of this in Sephora’s Play Smarts K-Skincare Box. I’ve liked every one of the Belif products I’ve tried, but this might be one of my favorites. I like Belif’s lighter “Aqua Bomb“ moisturizer, but this one might even be more perfect for my dry skin! This is like Aqua Bomb’s bigger, badder older sister. While this might be too rich for oily or some with combination skin, I think this is a real win for those of us who have dry and/or aging skin. This has quickly become a favorite night cream for me and is going to be really perfect for extra dry winter skin. This has a very light herbal scent which gives it a nice apothecary vibe. I highly recommend this, along with many other products by Belif.

review_text: I read up a little on Belif and this brand was launched a couple of years ago by LG, the other big Korean beauty brand along with Amore Pacific. They used the Napiers (British herbalist) technology and launched Belif. The moisturizing bomb is (online data; can’t vouch for accuracy) their number one selling item and a huge hit in Asia.Basically, it targets dry skin and is full of so many amazing herbal and floral (flowers) ingredients.On me the light cream absorbs beautifully and keeps my skin hydrated. I’m a huge fan. I also tend to favor Korean skin care brands as they are devoid of “bad“ ingredients but, like this product, full of nourishing ones.This product has - to me - a light scent though others have noticed a stronger one. But is claims to have no artificial fragrance so I guess that’s the ingredients.Hear more, see the ingredients list and the cream itself in the video.

review_text: I have combination skin and this redness that surfaces when my skin is dry. I’ve tried quite a bit of moisturizers in my lifetime including expensive ones like Drunk elephant’s Protini, Dr. Jart ceramidin cream, Sunday Riley water enzyme, and the latest, Tatcha dewy skin cream, and nothing works like how belif’s moisturizing bomb does. I was in disbelief (no pun intended) myself because I thought the more expensive creams should do a better job. But somehow this cream not only locks in the moisture for hours, but leaves my skin feeling plumper and overall hydrated without a greasy feel or anything. I know when my skin isn’t adequately hydrated because it turns more red and I always have reduced redness when I use this compared to other moisturizers. This is like my 5th time repurchasing this cream because nothing ever works the same and I end up coming back to this one.

review_text: I have normal skin, with a small patch of dry, flaky skin underneath my brow bone. I assumed it was some kind of skin condition that I should probably see a dermatologist for, since no moisturizer would ever fully soothe it. I bought this not even looking for a solution, just as a new moisturizer. This product is literally the bomb. The texture is somewhere between a cream and a whip, it sinks into the skin so quickly and I don’t have to rub and tug on my face. It’s so soft and non-intrusive, there’s no annoying fragrance and I know it will last me all night despite the light weight texture. As a bonus, the dry patch around my eye is gone, and only pops up if I skip on an application. Will never have to try a new moisturizer again!

review_text: I don’t typically splurge on skincare, but it has become my new favourite category, and this product might also be one of my new favourites! A little goes a long way with this cream!! It’s thick, but goes on nice and smoothly and doesn’t leave white residue. To see how the product really affects my skin, I decided to stop using it for a day and there is a difference!! My face did not feel nearly as bouncy and moisturized. This is going to be perfect to get my skin through winter!

review_text: (For reference - I’m 23 with oily sensitive skin) I used to use tatcha’s the water cream and I tried this one out because I thought my skin looked dehydrated (itchy, fine lines, looked tired etc) and this brand says they’re good for dehydrated skin as opposed to just dry skin. I have very oily skin And struggle with redness and sensitivity. This product was surprising because my main concern was the fine lines I was getting from my skin being dehydrated, but after using this a couple times I realized my redness was going way down and my skin felt less irritated. When I’ve tried some other products the irritation and redness come back so I think this product is the difference, so I’d say this moisturizer is very good for sensitive skin ! A nice bonus I wasn’t expecting , I already use another product for redness that works pretty well but adding this helped a lot . As for how this works on fine lines- i used to spend a couple minutes each night Examining my face In the mirror like looking at my fine lines on my forehead and trying to tell if they were getting worse day to day (not a good habit but i have terrible lighting in my bathroom lol). I didn’t see a difference in my fine lines at first, but then after a couple months of using this moisturizer I realized i hadn’t looked at my fine lines anymore , and I checked and they looked super faint and minimal and way better than they used to be . This is the only product I changed in my routine . Obviously no product works miracles and nothing is going to give Instagram-filter like skin but switching to this moisturizer has made my skin feel a lot more comfortable and it looks a lot healthier now and I think the added hydration is helping keep my fine lines minimal ! I think this is a great product if you’re looking for something simple and non irritating to help with fine lines and sensitivity without all the acids and exfoliants that they keep adding to moisturizers recently

This moisturiser looks, feels, and goes on lightweight, but packs a hydration-punch alright - so much so that it makes a good combination with prescription tretinoin (which I’m using for acne treatment). Not only does the moisturiser not break me out, but it also prevents the horrible dryness and flaking that usually accompanies acne treatment. I’m not sure if the hydration lasts for 26 hours as claimed, but my skin is certainly not dry at any time, and makeup goes on smoothly, without any dry patches on my skin.

Everyone’s skin is different, but this stuff is perfect for me!

review_text: So I bought this on a whim because I was looking for a good aqua/gel moisturizer, and this one had great reviews. When I bought it I was excited. So much more hydrating that previous moisturizers. I have combo skin, so my t zone gets slick and my cheeks can get so dry they flake, even in the summer. I still found myself having to use an oil with this for my cheeks. I ran out and decided to buy the neutrogena sensitive skin hydro boost because it was half the price and was floored at the difference. I didn’t have a lot of experience with gel moisturizers so I thought belif was great but I was mistaken. The neutrogena moisturizer completely eliminated the need for oil. I ran out and went back to this belif moisturizer because I had been lazy and my dry flaky cheeks came back. If you have dry skin I don’t recommend this, but if you have normal or oily skin it might be great. The belif moisturizer kept my t zone from getting too oily, but honestly the neutrogena did miles better than this, and it’s really only have the price. Definitely keep trying more stuff out there before you settle entirely on this.

review_text: Ever since I incorporated tretinoin into my skincare regimen in order to combat acne, my combo/oily skin became unbearably dry, scaly, and sensitive. I’ve tried many white cream-based moisturizers, both high and low end, without success until I came upon this amazing holy-grail product. I was worried at first because my skin tends to react badly to alcohol denat./SD alcohol, which is commonly used in various cosmetics and skincare products. However, this product is lightweight, absorbs extremely quickly, and leaves no residue despite the generous amount I apply each morning and night. I highly recommend this product to those who have had no luck with white moisturizing creams, or even other gel-type creams. Tip: Store this in your refrigerator for an even more cooling and refreshing experience!

review_text: I got a foil packet sample of this in my last Sephora order. I’m always up for trying a new moisturizer, and this one really delivered for me. As someone with dry skin, I would use this as a day cream. It provides a nice burst of moisture yet absorbs quickly, so it makes a nice base for applying my foundation and/or concealers. This is not thick or hydrating enough for me to consider it for night, but it might be for many people with oilier skin. I also happen to like the scent, which is sort of light and fresh and herbal. This was the first product from Belif I have sampled, and I am pretty impressed. I’d like to get a deluxe sample to try, because this could be a contender for my top 5 favorite daytime moisturizers!

review_text: I would lather this stuff all over my body if I could, it’s so hydrating and softening--especially for anyone with dry, sensitive skin. Kind of frustrating that the description says for “normal, oily or combination“ skin. Me, being a “sensitive“ and “very dry“ skin type person, I look for that on the product. Thankfully, I got a tester of this product in my Ipsy--thank god because if it weren’t for this I probably wouldn’t have tried this product simply because it didn’t say anything about dry skin types! I am also prone to breakouts (and I know everyone is different) but this stuff hasn’t given me a problem at all with breakouts or skin sensitivity and I use it 2x a day!

review_text: So I recently started using differin at night. (a retinoid). Since then, I have had burning when I apply any moisturizer, even on parts of my face like eye area where I hadn’t applied differin. Totally messed up my routine since I didnt know what to use. I tried stuff for sensitive skin, still burned. SO I went into sephora and the nice lady recommended this. I was hesitant since so many things had left me disappointed, but I bought it. OMG the big test came tonight, I appplied and waited for the fire..... nope! Cooling and soothing without a flare of red and fire. So glad! Hallelujah! I was starting to give up on the differin since I couldn’t find a moisturizer up until this point that agreed with it. Retinoids make your skin so sensitive that even applying powder on your face with a powder brush is irritating and can be uncomfortable. Glad I found this. Thanks Sephora!

review_text: I use Belif’s true cream moisture bomb for MOST of the year. I have REALLY dry skin, and it’s one of the only moisturizer’s hydrating enough for me. But for summer, I got 2 deluxe samples of the aqua bomb (in 2 different kits from Sephora over this past year), which is a gel cream (the moisture bomb is a white cream with a different texture), and it is PERFECT for summer. Any other time of year my skin is WAY too dry using the aqua bomb. But in the summer, especially under makeup, it’s perfect!! So I will continue to use it in July and August for sure. I just don’t need to purchase a full size of it because for dry skin, this is a summertime ONLY product. The rest of the year I will buy the moisture bomb, which is my HG! However, if you have combo/oily skin I could see you being able to use this year round!

review_text: Historically I’ve always shied away from gel type moisturizers because I have super dry skin and the formulas were never hydrating enough for me. I felt like it would soak into my skin instantly and then my skin would be dry again the next minute but the aqua bomb definitely changed my mind!! I applied a thick layer of aqua bomb after using the Belif Hungarian Water Essence at night before heading to bed and was so surprised to wake up the next morning with my skin feeling so moisturized!! I would say my skin is very sensitive and I haven’t had any problems after using this product daily for the last 2 weeks. Would definitely recommend, I’ll have to get a refill soon!!

review_text: I know that i said that I love this product, and i really do, I’ve only used one other moisturizer and it was the clinique moisturizing gel (which was my go to), i prefer the applicator on the clinique. I gotta say it is kinda messy to apply with the aqua bomb. I have normal to dry skin. Formula wise,it made my hands feel a little sticky after rubbing it on my face with my hands, but that’s with all gel moisturizers. What matters is how my face felt, and let me tell you, it felt AMAZING! It made my skin feel cool, refreshed, and hydrated. It drys quickly which is a plus, because it gives me time to apply my primer before my makeup. I would usually have to wait to apply my primer. But get this, i use this as my moisturizer and primer, its basically a 2 in 1 product and its the best! Over all i would highly recommend this product.

review_text: I’ve become a fan of belif’s brand in the last year or so, first receiving a mini of the Moisturizing Bomb through Sephora PLAY! I picked up the Aqua Bomb in a mini’s set after my positive experience with the Moisturizing Bomb, and there’s a distinct difference in performance for me between the two. Aqua Bomb smells nice (light, lemon scent without reminding me of household cleansers), dries down and doesn’t leave any odor behind, applies easily, packaging is simple and easy to manipulate. Unfortunately, Aqua Bomb doesn’t hydrate my skin well enough; I either need to supplement it with something else, or completely re-apply it - something that doesn’t sit well with me at this price point and will cause problems if I require foundation or coverage of any kind. review_text: I got this stuff as a sample and I knew immediately as I ran out of the packets I needed a full size. I suffer from acne prone skin and I’m so hesitant to put on anything (i.e. moisturizers, makeup, etc). I try to stay away from putting on foundation and my skin has been so good since using this. It keeps my skin insanely hydrated all day and gives me a glow without using any type of foundation or tinted moisturizer. I definitely recommend this product.. also a little goes a LONG way. A few tiny dots and your face is covered. It was perfect in the winter and kept my face balanced and hydrated. Now that we’re moving into the warmer, humid months where I live, I see that it is still holding up and is doing its job. Thumbs up for me. Wish it had a pump so all the bacteria wouldn’t get in there (and maybe some SPF but I guess that would change the overall consistency of the product). As a result, I apply it with a stick or break a q-tip in half and apply it using that.. breaking it in half gives you more applicators and you don’t waste as many. Hope this helps!

review_text: I LOVE LOVE LOVE this moisturizer.  Used it initially as a sample during the summertime (great as a lightweight moisturizer) and I will continue to use it year-round.  It is light and gel-like and my skin is so supple after using it.  Doesn’t leave your face feeling greasy/oily at all! I do use it in addition to Belif’s hungarian water essence, which is also light but dries quickly as a layer underneath the aqua bomb.  If you’re not looking to purchase 2 items though, this one is good enough on its own.  My boyfriend has oily skin and I have combo, and it moisturizes both of our skin types well. Bonus: according to Belif if you pack on a lot on your face you’ve got a super moisturizing face mask! Love doing this after exfoliating.

review_text: To start, the smell reminds me of products my little brother’s grandmother used to always use.  I wasn’t aware that I had a smell-based memory trigger for her; she wasn’t a decent person...so, that wasn’t pleasant.  I still tried it for a week, since it was a free product for review program, and I’d have to in order to give an honest review.  It felt pleasant. Not greasy.  But it didn’t feel...satisfyingly moisturizing.  Like I still needed to go back to my regular face moisturizer as well (I went one day without doing so) before my skin would feel right...less tight and dry as it does after washing my face. I felt it sink in, but then it still felt  like it was sitting on top of my skin.  Though it didn’t leave a residue that my fingers felt much at all.   I didn’t want to keep having the smell right in my face, so I stopped using it after a week.  I didn’t notice much change in one way or another that was an improvement on the basic face products I regularly use.  So maybe, in my case, it’s just not a formulation that is right for my skin, or at this point in my skin’s ageing.   So while it isn’t something I’ll keep using, I will select positively in the recommend/don’t recommend options below.  I’ve spent a bit looking up reviews and information on several other sites and cosmeceutical reports/research/news sites and, for one, it has review averages similar to those here, all over the place.  Something that overwhelmingly approved of is worth giving a try. Despite my odd-one-out personal feelings and results about it.

review_text: The It Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream has a soft, creamy, moisturizing feel to it just to the touch. Dry skin loves it. I like to think of my skin as combination-ish, leaning more towards dry (I used to be very oily). It can easily be worked in to the skin so that’s pretty quick moisturization for the thickness of the cream. My apprehension was on it breaking me out as I’ve tried other moisturizers that were on the same level of thickness and ended up with issues, but so far so good. I’m a big fan of niacinamide for evening skin tone as it is in some of my current products and have heard squalane is great for skin hydration so we shall see the results over time.  A little goes a long way so it’ll last for quite a while. Bring on the anti-aging! Don’t skip your neck! Thanks to BzzAgent and It Cosmetics for introducing me to this moisturizer.

review_text: While I won’t say this is a bad product, I will say that it’s just not the product for me. What I liked about it is that it provided a lot of moisture to the skin, but it felt thick on the skin even though you don’t have to use very much of the product. Compared to some other products I’ve used; you didn’t have to use much, and I did appreciate that because that means it’ll last a while. It did feel as if it was clogging my pores though. I did not like that. I did not see much difference when it comes to wrinkles and other skin imperfections, but maybe two weeks was not long enough to see results. Overall, I would not personally use the product, but it may work for others with different skin textures. I do feel that serums work best for me, not creams, so I do not recommend.

The product “promises“ to deliver a reduction on  the look of fine lines, visibly minimized pores, and brightening the look of skin. It’s think, lightly scented and absorbs perfectly, leaving me with soft, moisturized skin.  I usually brush my teeth while the cream works it’s magic, then I move on with the next step without skipping a beat.

I’ve tried a lot of skincare and so far this is one of my favorites that you don’t need a prescription to get. You get 2 ounces as opposed to the standard 1.7 ounces in a very weighted glass jar, it does have a sort of medicinal type scent so if you’re sensitive to that be careful or don’t select this product. It’s got a very creamy consistency that absorbs fairly quickly into skin, works beautifully under makeup, and is overall an excellent choice of facial cream. You wouldn’t be disappointed if you choose to pick it up.

review_text: This confidence in a cream is superbly creamy and smooth, almost like a Greek yogurt consistency. The jar is a nice, heavy container that feels substantial to handle, very elegant packaging for sure. I use this cream nightly, and apply it after my serum. It applies smoothly and easily, gliding over the skin and is absorbed readily. I feel like my skin is plumper after applying, and velvety to the touch after the cream dries. I like the cream so much, that I don’t wash it off in the morning. I apply my morning skin care right over top followed by my makeup. A very small amount (pea size) is all I use every day, and that is definitely sufficient. It has such nice spreadability that I don’t need any more than that! Since I’ve been using this cream, my skin has been smoother, softer, and most notably, it is plumper! I really enjoy this cream and would recommend it to anyone.

Definitely recommend this moisturizer and love that it’s for all skin types.

review_text: As someone with hypersensitive skin, rosacea, and psoriasis (even on my face), I’ve learned the hard way that I just can’t use a lot of skin products, even higher end and ones specifically for sensitive skin. I have found some IT Cosmetics were okay on my skin, so I really wanted to try this cream now that I’m in my mid-forties and starting to really notice age-related changes in my skin. The texture of this is gorgeous. I was afraid it would be like a heavy night cream, but it’s lovely, and my skin seemed to absorb it pretty much right away, which isn’t always the case. Although I’ve gotten a little bumpiness from my rosacea, this hasn’t made me fully flare, and I’m hoping that my skin adjusts because I love how this makes my skin feel. I haven’t noticed wrinkles disappearing yet, but it’s only been a month, and it’s summer, so my skin isn’t as dry as it will be in a months. review_text: I’ve used Confidence in a Cream in the past, and while this updated “supercharged“ version is very similar to its predecessor, it does have a few differences. This Confidence feels both more hydrating and lighter, but it still wouldn’t be my go-to for a summer moisturizer. Like the original, it is thick and creamy without too much of a smell. The retinol content is low enough for my somewhat sensitive skin to handle on an every other day basis, but for those with very sensitive skin, I would be inclined to give it a pass. This newer version did not seem to be too heavy to break me out like the previous iteration, but that may be different for everyone. All in all, it’s a lovely moisturizer with a few minor drawbacks, but I doubt it will ever be my first choice.

review_text: Let me start by saying what I liked: the light scent, the way it quickly absorbs into my oily/combo/acne-prone skin, the smooth fresh feeling once it’s soaked in, and how a little goes a long way. It works well under makeup and is not sticky, greasy, or heavy. It is so light in fact that I forget I even put it on. That leads me to what I didn’t like about it: not very moisturizing (but it does lightly hydrate—meaning my skin doesn’t feel dry or tight but doesn’t necessarily feel plush and moisturized). It’s pricey and you don’t get a lot. I think I would recommend this for very oily skin types in the summer or very humid climates; but it needs to be layered with other products because it doesn’t provide enough moisture on its own, despite the name, and there’s no spf protection. I don’t hate it but I’m not rushing to buy it either.

review_text: As a newbie in the skincare game (literally coming from using Dove sensitive skin body wash and drugstore moisturizer on my face), I spent DAYS researching products. I combed through reviews, spent hours watching Beauty Within on youtube, and read through dozens of ’Best of’ lists from top beauty companies. I was looking for something with little to no fragrance, a lighter formula, and gentle active ingredients. My skin is dry/ combination but very sensitive. I decided to give two of the best-known moisturizers  for sensitive skin a chance: Drunk Elephant Protini and Tatcha The Water Cream.Protini is one of the best things I’ve ever placed on my face! I love the portion control aspect of the applicator, and the texture is light and creamy. It absorbs within minutes and leaves my skin feeling baby soft right after application and all day/night after. When I go to wash my face next, I can still feel the velvety softness of the moisturizer under my fingers as I’m wetting my face for my cleanser. It is truly fragrance free, and I can’t stop touching my face after I apply this stuff- Its seriously magic.The Tatcha Water Cream has a wonderful, magical feeling as it converts from a light cream to a water right on your face. However, I noticed that it takes a LONG time (upwards of 20 minutes) for it to fully absorb into my skin where I don’t feel it coming off on my fingers if I touch my face. It feels heavier and greasier on my skin until it fully absorbs, and it doesn’t have the same ’still there’ feeling when I go to wash my face later, making me think its just too lightweight for me. Its application is also messier- it comes with a little golden spoon to help you scoop some product out of the jar in a hygienic,portion-controlled way, but I always seem to get product on the rim of the jar or all over the lid. Otherwise, its smell is light and pleasant and it did its job of lightweight moisturizing.Overall: both are amazing, but Protini definitely wins out for me!

I found it overly scented and while at first I thought it was what was listed as botanicals giving off the scent it was actually fragrance. I know that is a major skin irritant so I still don’t understand why high end brands add it to their products. I want it to work, it doesn’t need to smell heavily perfumed to do the job. I also found that while it felt nice on my skin it clogged the pores on my nose, forehead and chin so I had little bumps everywhere. I don’t know what it was that caused this but so far I’ve never encountered anything that did that to my skin. I find that Tatcha products have beautiful packaging but that’s about all for me. So far not impressed with the brand and I have purchased their cleanser, facial spray and exfoliator in the past.

If you also have problems with your foundation looking patchy or cakey around your nose try putting some of this cream around there before foundation it really solves the problem!! Side note: I have tried a bunch of “hydrating“ primers for this problem but none have helped like this cream.

review_text: This is the first product I have ever tried from this brand. It comes in very nice packaging; a heavy component with a little spoon applicator to scoop out the product. It has a very nice scent to it that dissipates quickly. The texture is very nice; a thin cream that melts into a water-like texture, which sunk nicely into my skin without just drying out immediately or just sitting on top of my skin & leaving a weird shine. My skin felt firm, hydrated, & bouncy! There could very well be more inexpensive dupes out there, but I have yet to find them.  Though the price point is on the higher end, I did not regret the purchase & you don’t need much of the product for it to go a long way. I have dry-combination skin: an oily T zone with large pores & my cheeks get so dry, dry, & even chapped. This has the perfect balance of hydrating the most where my face needs it as well as not making my oily parts even greasier in appearance! The texture of this product is just perfection. As the weather gets colder here in Michigan, I may try the Dewy version of this product once I run out of what I have. But so far I haven’t felt the need to switch. You get what you pay for & I’m very happy with what I paid for!

review_text: For those with naturally oily or sensitive skin, beware. I used the sample and thought it was great so I purchased the full size. It was about a few weeks later when I started getting small, clogged pores in weird areas that I never had before. I immediately stopped using it to see if this was the reason and I noticed a difference but I wasn’t convinced. I decided to only start using it on my neck and lower face to see if that caused any reactions since I never breakout there. I got a pimple on my neck and a few on my lower face a week later and I knew right away, this is the culprit. Clogged pores can be caused by things used up to 4-5 weeks prior, so be careful. This is FULL of silicones though. There’s no question this is not the right product for those with sensitive or oily skin, or those with enlarged pores.

review_text: goes on super light, almost feels light like water. mild pleasant smell. feels slightly sticky to the touch, gives skin a moist look. directions recommend a pearl sized amt which provides decent moisture on my dryish, sensitive accutane skin. no breakouts but since im on accutane i dont get acne anymore. my problem: applying more than a pearl size makes my foundation highlight pores just like primers sometimes do. you know what im talking about; when you brush foundation over an area like your nose or sides of nose and you can see a dot of foundation inside each pore. it sometimes made my foundation look streaky on areas where i put extra moisturizer, as if i rubbed a line and theres a balled up line of smeared foundation. thus, if you dont need a lot of hydration and wear no foundation this could be great. if you have skin which needs more than a pearl size AND wear foundation then this could cause issues.

review_text: I really wanted to love Tatcha products. I have this cream, their Vitamin C Serum, and the Dewey Skin cream and honestly I feel it’s all a bit overrated, especially for the price point. This cream is the most overrated in my opinion, it feels lovely when you put it on, smooth and light, but then my skin feels dry a half hour later and I feel like I have to reapply constantly. During the summer here in FL while it’s very hot and humid I can use this as a night cream as well. I’ve found a new love - a high quality, unique product like this is worth every penny so I’m ordering the full size.

review_text: This moisturizer literally feels like a splash of water on the skin. I have oily skin, so I really appreciate how light this is and how quickly it sinks in. Works well with my other products and wears well under makeup. I wouldn’t recommend this for dry skin — I’m not sure it would provide enough moisture — but it’s great for my oily skin.  My only issue with this is that I occasionally have dehydrated skin, and on those days, I find this isn’t quite hydrating enough. I always feel like I need to supplement with an additional moisturizer when I’m feeling especially dehydrated. This reminds me A LOT of the Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench, but the PTR is more hydrating for me, so I prefer it on days my skin is really dehydrated. Otherwise, this is a lovely moisturizer for oily skin. On a side note, the Tatcha packaging is really gorgeous. It feels super luxurious to me. The little tub it comes in feels weighty and the aqua color is beautiful. Also, it comes with a tiny spatula which I like because you don’t have to stick your fingers in the tub. If you’re into packaging and the overall experience of a product, this is one of the best.

full_text: One of the best moisturizers. I have fairly oily skin, and am always looking for a moisturizer that works best with my skin type. review_text: Okay, now that I have been using this for about three months now, I can finally write a review and feel satisfied with the feedback I’m giving. I have moderately oily skin so I chose the water cream on that basis alone. I had also heard really good things about the brand from beauty bloggers, as I’m sure most have. However, I feel like there’s more hype than actual results. While my skin does feel soft after use, it does not help with oil control or anything like that. I don’t mind using it, I just can’t justify spending $70 on a product that does the same thing a $20 moisturizer would. Unless you have money to throw away on a name, don’t waste your time with this one.

review_text: I purchased and used this product for 2 weeks as the final step in my nighttime skincare routine. As someone with oily, sensitive skin who is very acne-prone, this moisturizer unfortunately was not the one for me. The main drawback was the fact that I would wake up in the morning and feel very greasy, which does not happen when I use other brands of light creams/moisturizers. The fact that there are so many fragrant components as well is a concern for me, as I worry that I could develop sensitivity over time. I will say, however, the experience of putting this cream on your face is amazing and is almost worth the high price tag. It smells amazing without being too strong or overpowering, and the texture is great (light cream that turns watery on the skin). I could definitely see why people love this product, it just wasn’t my holy grail.

review_text: I really wanted to hate this because it is SO expensive. But after trying a tiny sample, I had to order the real thing. I have no regrets. This product is completely worth the hype.I have oily/combo VERY acne-prone skin, and I’ve never found a moisturizer that really works for me. I’ve been using the Effaclar and it’s fine-ish, but still wasn’t really doing what I wanted it to, but it wasn’t breaking me out so I took it. For all of my high school years and much of my college years (I’m 22 now), I didn’t even use moisturizer because I was sick of dealing with the struggle of finding one that didn’t make me oily or break me out. This is perfect. It absorbs right into the skin, moisturizes effectively, doesn’t break me out, and provides a good base for foundation. I noticed immediately when I started using it that my face was significantly less oily throughout the day when I used this moisturizer in the morning. I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to turn back.

review_text: The ingredients list on this was initially very impressive to me: squalane, urea.. there are some heavy moisturizing hitters on this and the texture of it is really pleasant.But the texture of it is pleasant because its top ingredients are silicones, like cyclohexasiloxane.This explained a lot for me. I used this cream daily for two months before returning it. My skin FELT moisturized to the touch, but was exhibiting these symptoms of extreme dehydration nonetheless. I even had my skin clinically tested for moisture levels to confirm it was very dehydrated. I think this would be a great cream if you don’t find that you have dry skin. And remember that oily skin can also be dry skin! In fact your skin may be producing extra oil BECAUSE it’s dry! So if you have really balanced skin and just need an extra oomph in the winter, this could be for you. But if you sincerely have dehydrated skin, I found that the presence of silicone emollients may make the texture of the product really nice, but they stopped the product from being properly moisturizing for me. Lots of emollients does not a good moisturizer make!

review_text: This cream saved skin. I have very reactive skin, I develop allergic symptoms such rashes, redness, etc to almost all skincare products. After using the same moisturizer for over 6 years, I developed an allergic reaction to it out of nowhere. My skin was just really angry, it was bumpy, patchy, red and stings when I use the moisturizer. Although it wasn’t the best moisturizer, I used it because it was the only one that didn’t cause a reaction. Out of desperation, I bought Kiehl’s Ultra cream after the sales associate reassured me that if it didn’t work, I can return it zero questions asked. Within 15mins of the first application, my skin feels better and my complexion bright up almost instantly. It calm my angry skin within a day. I don’t know what magic is in this cream but I’m so happy to have given it a chance.  It moisturize well without feeling greasy. It gives the skin a nice radiance, subtle dew to the skin. I will use this for life, fingers crossed that I won’t develop an allergic reaction. Been using this for 3 weeks and every morning, skin looks great after waking up.

review_text: Kiehl’s is one of my favorite skincare brands and this Ultra Facial Cream with Squalane did not disappoint. It comes in a nice-sized tube and boasts claims to hydrate and moisturize the skin for 24 hours. I find that this is to be true and when I wake up, my skin feels moisturized and the hydration is still sealed in. The olive-derived squalane, glycerine and glacial glycoprotein helps to restore the skin’s moisture barrier. What really impresses me is the texture of the cream - while moisturizing, it still feels “light“ and whipped as well. It absorbs well into the skin and leaves no sticky or heavy residue. Although this is moisturizing enough as a night cream, it would be wonderful as a day cream as well and layers very well over my other skincare products and underneath makeup. This would be a great formula for those with sensitive skin as there is no fragrance! I would definitely recommend to my friends and family and would repurchase this product myself. The price is great and affordable for a high-end skincare brand. I love Kiehl’s product lines and the ingredients they use.

Would not repurchase though and do not recommend.

The Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream with Squalane leaves my very dry skin moisturized for the majority of the day, does not clog my pores or any other negatives you can run into with some moisturizers. I haven’t been able to evaluate long term results, since I have only been using it for a few weeks. I do like it, nothing stands out about it but it is a good basic dependable moisturizer made with good ingredients.

review_text: I heard really great things about this facial moisturizer so I decided to give it a try. I’ve been prescribed Tretinoin for over a year now (I’m way past the purging stage) but my skin went from being extremely oily to extremely dry. I’ve been layering moisturizers and thought that this one would be nice and rich and just what I needed in my routine. While it felt lovely and sank into the skin nicely, I’m fairly certain it broke me out. Even on my prescribed medication, I was getting large, painful bumps underneath the skin. I used it up just because I hate wasting products and this one is quite pricy, but I would warn against it if you have sensitive acne-prone skin. There was nothing else in my routine that could have broken me out, and anytime I switched moisturizers it was clear that it was this one causing the breakouts. If you have really dry skin I think you would love this moisturizer, but I would recommend trying a sample of it before committing.

review_text: I received this product complimentary, which is why I gave this a shot in the summer months. My skin type is oily to combo, being the most oily and acne prone in the summer. My skin loves some lighter hydration in the cooler months, but in the summer I really need to get my skin on lock and use more oil control and mattifying products. With that being said, I will give this product another chance when we move until fall/winter. It’s a sort of cream-gel hybrid, but I would say it’s more cream than gel. It does absorb into the skin nicely and leaves a nice finish, but unfortunately it just can’t control my oil production during these summer months. If you’re a normal to dry skin type, this is a great light weight moisturizer to use during the summer!

review_text: I use this product on the reg and I absolutely love it! I don’t wear make up on the day-to-day but I don’t like feeling as if my bare skin is vulnerable. This moisturizer dries with a matte finish that makes my face feel smooth and not completely naked. To top it off, I’m guilt free about putting in on my face because the ingredients list is so clean. I have naturally oily skin that tends to dry out and peel around my nose and cheeks. I’ve been using this moisturizer for over a year and have found the peeling has stopped and my face is less oily at the end of the day. The only downfall, if you would even call it that, is that there is no spf so if you are concerned about sun exposure you may want to use something else instead of/in addition to this moisturizer.

review_text: I am a self proclaimed skincare fanatic and I have used many different skincare products from Sephora so I was grateful to be able to try this brand new moisturizer complimentary for testing purposes. Straight off the bat, this moisturizer has an amazing citrusy scent—  a fragrance that is strong and perfumey is a deal breaker for me no matter how great the product may be (I’m looking at you, AmorePacific!) Lovely color as well, a translucent light pink that looks luxurious and girly. From there, it has an incredibly unique texture. It starts off feeling like your typical gel cream moisturizer when applied to your face, but in minutes, it dries down to a velvet- matte, almost powdery finish. I’m guessing from the ingredients list that it’s because of the silica. It is seriously mattifying. Even using my dewiest foundations on top of this moisturizer gave them a more matte finish. As a result, my makeup lasted longer so I would definitely consider this a double duty moisturizer and primer 2 in 1 product for oily skin. The reason I am docking this 1 star is because unlike the description states, I did not find it suitable on dry skin. It simply did not provide sufficient hydration and even dewy foundation on top of this moisturizer emphasized texture and crepiness. However if your skin is oily and you wish to replace your silicone based primers, this will for sure be a win for you!

review_text: I got this as part of a trio from the Origins Original skin line. I will say this is a perfect moisturizer for oily skin. It leaves the face feeling like satin as though you set your face with a translucent powder. I tend to be normal to dry so on me this left my face feelin very matte. On hot days, this is perfect but to keep my skin from drying out too much, I would have paired this with a hydrating serum or a few daps of skin oil to my cheeks and nose. This left my forehead staying matte all day. The initial scent is of a citrus blend reminding me of the Ole Henriksen African Red Tea Foaming Cleanser. The smell quickly dissapates so for those who have a sensitive nose, this should be ok. It is a gel-like consistency with a light pink hue but don’t worry this will not cause any skin staining. For me personally, I would not use this all over, only in my T-zone areas. For oily individuals, you will most likely apply all over face, giving a beautiful semi-matte finish with dinished look of pores and fine lines. review_text: I absolutely LOVE this moisturizer. This product is overall very, very impressive. The smell is amazing, which gave a great first impression. This moisturizer smells floral, but is not overpowering AT ALL. Although this is not a citrus based product... it smells fresh, and slightly reminds me of the Tarte Rainforest of the Sea Drink of H2O Hydrating Boost Moisturizer as well. Besides the AMAZING scent, the moisturizer itself is quite impressive as well. It truly hydrates the skin without leaving an oily feel (because it instantly mattifies the skin). Therefor (although I have normal skin), I believe this moisturizer would be great for all skin types. It is soothing on the skin. The Willowherb plant is a natural pain reliever and anti-intflammatory, so it is great for sore, acne prone skin (like I have). This moisturizer amazed me because as I worked it into my skin, it instantly mattifyed my skin and acted as a redness reducer and primer! My face was instantly ready for foundation. Thankful that Influenster and Origins sent this this product to me complimentary to test out!

review_text: My skin is so oily I actually wear a full face of makeup because I find foundation helps absorb some of my oil. I bought a trial kit that came with this moisturizer and a cleanser and I packed this on a nature trip last fall where I had no intention of wearing makeup. I was amazed at how hydrated yet matte my skin was all day. I use different moisturizers in the winter to combat dry and flaky skin, but this is excellent for other seasons. However, I must admit I’m getting annoyed with high end brands packaging their products in tubs and jars, expecting us to shove our fingers in them. It’s just not sanitary! The trial size I got was a squeezy tube and I really wished the full sized product came in better packaging.

review_text: Love this! I have pretty normal skin/combo, with some dryness in winter. Mostly acne-free. I got the smaller sample of this (with an open jar, not a push-top like this one has, so I can’t comment on this packaging). I was able to use it for a very long time - a little went a long way.My favourite is to put it on at night after washing my face (often using No. 9 Jelly cleanser first, but not always that one). When I woke up in the morning, my skin just looked refreshed, plump and moisturized, and brighter. My forehead is regular skin (but almost a little oily normally), so I found that my forehead area would look extra-moisturized in the morning from this product, so I would use my hands to rub the excess from my skin to the rest of my face. Or I just wouldn’t apply to my forehead. Nonetheless, it never was greasy or broke me out in forehead or anywhere else.If this product wasn’t so expensive, it would be my new go-to! Time to add it to my Xmas list..

review_text: This is a good moisturizer that leaves your skin feeling soft, matte and hydrated. HOWEVER, the 50 ml jar lasted 2 months only to me, using it twice a day! I pressed the lid to up to the bottom to get a pump of product, which I thought was a normal decent amount of moisturizer. review_text: I’ll admit, the price had me PAUSE big time. But I have friends who swear by this brand, and I’m so so tired of my red and blotchy skin that nothing really seemed to improve, so I gave this a shot. I’m so glad that I did.I’ve been using this for about a week now (in combination with the B-Hydra serum) and WOW!! Talk about a difference already!! My nose is especially rosacea-prone and it’s been awesome to see it literally getting better by the day. I don’t know how many other brands I’ve tried with no effect on it at all. Most moisturizers either don’t do much for me or are sooo sloppy it drives me crazy. This is perfect, lightweight and absorbs like a dream. One pump only delivers a small bit of product, but that is really all you need!My skin is super sensitive too so most products leave my face and especially my nose glowing a bright red after application. The ingredients in this must finally be the golden ticket because I haven’t seen that at all. My skin feels nice and smooth! I’m so happy to keep using it and watch my face get even better.

review_text: I have to say I initially though it wouldnt be the worst thing if this product doesnt work because of the price point of DE products, but I’m much happier that it actually is a great product worthy of all the positive reviews and worth the money to me. I’m 39 with sensitive, combo skin and started to see fine lines and sun damage in my 30s. I get very occasional breakouts, but do have a consistently slightly oily tzone. I was hoping to find a product that worked for my sensitive skin, moisturized enough to make a difference and didnt break me out. Success on all counts! The product has become my go to daily moisturizer. I was using at night with a few drops of facial oil and now in winter I’m using it twice a day with DE C-Firma in the am (I do prefer DE B Hydra in the am with the C Firma in hotter, humid months). The consistency is thicker than most creams I’ve used only because I tend to prefer gel-creams or light serums so I dont get too oily. However the protini cream blends right into my skin and I don’t need to use much to cover my face and neck. Bonus theres no added fragrance so no worries for smells which I’m also sensitive too. I did learn to only push the pump halfway down at a time so I didnt pump too much out and waste product. When combined with the C-firma in the am it does initially look a little milky, but rest assured it will blend right in if you havent used too much of either product. I’ve used the DE Protini and C-firma for several months now and definitely notice that my skin feels more balanced overall in terms of oily/dryness, fine lines seem a little better and mild improvements in age spots around my eyes. I’ve never been great about consistently sticking with a product as I like to sample new products and always looking for something that both benefits my skin but also safe for my sensitive skin (lots of patch test horror stories). Protini cream is one of only a few products I’ve found myself consistently as it hits both those goals for me

review_text: For some reason, I’ve been reluctant to try Drunk Elephant in the past. Maybe it’s because what works for many people is usually a nightmare for my super sensitive, dry, rosacea skin. Then my normal skin care company changed my holy grail moisturizer, and I HATE IT. No other company made a moisturizer that did a whole lot for me in terms of getting my skin back to its normal fairly nice texture while providing enough moisture AND not making me blotchy or itchy. The ones that might work had aloe in them, and I’m allergic to aloe (of all things). I was really beginning to feel ugly and old-looking, and I’m only 40. I believe in aging gracefully and not fighting it, but I still want to look my best at any age. Then I read that Drunk Elephant was a clean brand and also doesn’t use silicone or essential oils in their products. The reviews for this and Lala were very convincing. I decided to try this first because it was lighter in texture for summer. One day was all it took. I’m a convert. The packaging is cute and clean. The moisturizer is long lasting and soothing. If there’s a scent, it’s very light, and I don’t notice it. My pores are smaller, my fine lines are diminished, my hyperpigmentation is lessened, and most of all, my face is COMFORTABLE. I’m no longer itchy, flaky, or burning. This feels amazing, and I actually look forward to applying this every day. It feels like a treat day at the spa. Worth. Every. Penny.

It wasn’t horrible or break me out, but after an hour or 2 I am left wondering if I ever applied moisturizer at all. If you have oily skin, this might be for you, but I need a THICCCC baby that’s gonna keep me moisturized throughout the day. I keep the sample in my desk and spot treat if there’s ever extreme dryness, but I don’t expect it to last long, and I would definitely never buy a full size of this product.

My every day foundation no longer looks flaky, and even without any makeup my skin tone is noticeably more even. Another plus is that a little goes a long way, and the small jar I got in my birthday gift in October will probably last me a while other month. review_text: I got this as a sample along with the Beste no. 9 Jelly Cleanser, and it is possibly my new favorite moisturizer. I have dry to combination skin, and I try to saturate my skin with thick moisturizers at night, which is when I use my heavier creams, but daytime I have trouble finding a moisturizer that isn’t too thick or greasy, or too water/gel based. I tried the Tatcha water cream and really didn’t care for it, which was shocking with all the great reviews it has and the high price tag. I generally tend to go back to the Clinique dramatically different moisturizing lotion because it is a good consistency for me, and of course, very affordable. However, this DE cream is probably my new go to. I have a half ounce sample I’ve been using for almost 2 weeks and I’ve barely made a dent in it. You really don’t need much product at all, which I love, especially with such a high price tag. it just sinks into your skin like silk and creates such a creamy, moisturized, rich feeling. It makes my skin tingle for just a few seconds and honestly, it feels so good! I’m someone who enjoys a little tingle or other sensation because it makes me feel like something is working. My skin is hydrated, plumped, refreshed, and so smooth! I love this stuff, it is really working for me and I definitely recommend it!

When I started using this product, so much acne appeared on my nose area that I have ever had before. So I stopped using this product and after 2 week, almost all the acne is gone minus a few red spots from where there was acne before.Just seems weird to me. I don’t have anything bad to say about this product but I suppose it didn’t react with my skin type well. That’s what I’m thinking.

review_text: The best thing about this cream, in my mind, is its ability to work well with a variety of other products. I can put it on top of different serums or under makeup and it still absorbs well, and doesn’t cause breakouts or bad reactions. The DE lala cream is more moisturizing, but if you’re looking for something a little lighter, this would be a good option. That said, for the same reason, this might not be the best choice for those with super dry skin, and on its own it’s not amazingly effective--it’s not an anti aging product, won’t do much to fill fine lines or things like that (again, though, it will help lock in serums that do). A LITTLE pricey for what it ultimately is, but bonus points for being clean and cruelty free!

review_text: I’m a bit surprised by all the reviews calling this moisturizer lightweight, because in my experience at least for 10-15 minutes after applying it feels like it’s sitting on top of the skin. It almost feels like it’s “suffocating“ the skin, as if it’s been wrapped in saran wrap. It’s quite an odd feeling that I’ve only experienced with heavy body lotions. I have normal to combo skin, so normally use lightweight gel moisturizers like the Cerave PM (though that one can feel too light in the winter). After the lotion absorbs, it does leave a very lovely velvety matte finish to the skin which feels very soft to the touch and not shiny (again, surprised by all the reviews saying this leaves a glow! definitely not my experience). I agree with a reviewer below that the texture of this feels very different than the sample, which felt much more liquidy and light. It may be that the dispenser concentrates the cream and squeezes out too much at once. I have been using half a pump which is more than enough for my face and neck. Overall, I likely won’t repurchase given the price.

full_text: sits on top of skin like saran wrap. I’m a bit surprised by all the reviews calling this moisturizer lightweight, because in my experience at least for 10-15 minutes after applying it feels like it’s sitting on top of the skin. It almost feels like it’s “suffocating“ the skin, as if it’s been wrapped in saran wrap. It’s quite an odd feeling that I’ve only experienced with heavy body lotions. I have normal to combo skin, so normally use lightweight gel moisturizers like the Cerave PM (though that one can feel too light in the winter). After the lotion absorbs, it does leave a very lovely velvety matte finish to the skin which feels very soft to the touch and not shiny (again, surprised by all the reviews saying this leaves a glow! definitely not my experience). I agree with a reviewer below that the texture of this feels very different than the sample, which felt much more liquidy and light. It may be that the dispenser concentrates the cream and squeezes out too much at once. I have been using half a pump which is more than enough for my face and neck. Overall, I likely won’t repurchase given the price.

review_text: I got this as a birthday gift, and was very excited considering the massive hype around this expensive skin care brand. When I first started using it, I was pretty impressed. The moisturizer is so lightweight and glides on effortlessly. The skin feels instantly moisturized and not greasy at all. However, after a couple weeks of regular use, I started breaking out in red spots all over. My diet didn’t change, I’m not allergic to anything, my skin isn’t sensitive, and my skincare routine didn’t change (except for this protini addition.) So I traced it back to this. After I stopped using this as a moisturizer, the red spots cleared and my skin went back to normal. For a cream this expensive and all the massive hype around it, I never expected this to happen. I never had trouble with any other moisturizers I have used. It also didn’t do much for darker spots either, as other reviewers have claimed. I wanted to love this, but it is not in any way worth the money. I won’t be trying any more products from this brand.

review_text: Protini is so effective I think of it as more of a serum than a traditional moisturizer. Yes, it is unusually hydrating, but after using it for only about 2 weeks, I have found it has improved my skin’s resiliency and firmness, as well as my overall tone through redness reduction. I read on the brand’s instagram that the level of peptides in this product is too high to meet regulations in a lot of countries. Hence, it can only be sold in the US and a few other places.I previously used NIOD’s CAIS (for about two years), which is the only mega-peptide product I can compare it to. Although that is also a good product that gave me an immediate boost, the effects were more subtle and not particularly lasting.I switched to an all-DE routine almost a year ago, and now use all their products except Baby Facial (which seems unnecessary to me). After I made the switch, I found that I could tolerate regular use of a high level of tretinoin (.07) for the first time, and my skin was generally less reactive and more consistent. So I would recommend using the DE system as a whole if you can afford to. You only need a little of each product so for me it has proved to be cheaper than mixing a lot of high and low end products.I have been using a ReFa S Carat microcurrent roller to work on firmness issues and am hopeful that I will continue to see results now that I am using it in conjunction with the Protini. I would also recommend this combination if you are starting to see signs of sagging (like me).

review_text: This is a great moisturizer for me - incredibly balancing. It soaks in so quickly, and is filled with such incredible ingredients that feel amazing on my skin. Mixes really well with their active ingredients - in the morning I mix with B-Hydra and C-Firma, and at night I mix with TLC Framboos and Marula Oil. I think my skin looks healthier and stronger and more hydrated (and thus more glowy and plump), and it provides the perfect moisture and hydration. I have normal to oily skin, but it can get dry patches and a little flaky in the winter, and this is great for balancing all areas of my skin - not too heavy, but does it’s job. Combined with their other products, my skin also feels brightened, more smooth, and hyperpigmentation is reduced. Taking off one star because $68 is so much and while I love the airless pump, the lid tends to come off too easily.
