review_text: First off, this product does deliver a glow that doesn’t clog pores, look oily, or break me out. Secondly, I have dry skin, and I pretty much ignored that this was marketed for Oily. I thought I might be the exception, but I wasn’t. I have combo, mostly dry skin, and I have one really dry patch. This did NOTHING to my dry patch, but in my combo/mildly dry areas it was really great. I’d say if you’re looking for a moisturizer that’s gonna quench dry skin, definitely skip this one. If you’re pretty dry, but not overly dry I would say give it a go, because the glow factor and smell of this (not to mention the cooling effect!) is really great, and that’s why I probably won’t be returning it. I think it would be great for people in the summer that are really dry in winter but their skin gets slightly oilier in the heat of summer. Alternatively, if you have VERY oily skin, this probably wouldn’t be the moisturizer for you. This is a product that is great for combo/normal skin. Not really dry, not really oily.

review_text: I’ve generally liked every product I have tried from Glow Recipe, so I was thrilled to get a sample of this to try. One thing to note is that this formula remains a bit tacky until it fully absorbs, and for me that takes about 20 minutes. This is not necessarily something I’d use by itself during the winter when my skin is at it’s driest, but I think this would be a great summertime night moisturizer. If you love the smell of watermelon, I highly recommend giving this a try, along with anything else from this collection.

review_text: I’ve been trying out the Watermelon Moisturizer that I received complimentary from Glow Recipe. I love to use it after toner and before my thicker moisturizer as a moisturizing serum and it definitely increases the hydration and glow to my skin. I also love that it’s really lightweight and has a very subtle tackiness that helps to grip makeup when used as a primer. The scent is a light, watermelon scent that I enjoy that isn’t overpowering or lingering so it doesn’t bother even the most sensitive to smells like myself.  I also love that you can use it with other skincare and it doesn’t leave any weird texture or pilling or anything that other skincare combos can. It works great in combination with the other Glow Recipe products too! The other day I used the watermelon toner, this moisturizer, the banana moisturizer and the avocado eye cream and loved the way my skin looked and felt! This is definitely not my first Glow Recipe product and will definitely nit be my last!

review_text: I absolutely love this moisturizer. Some of you may think the downside here is there is no SPF but I consider this a plus. I kinda hate wearing moisturizer with SPF then a foundation or BB cream with even more SPF - it just seems necessary and sometimes it just creates too much of a film/gives flashback in photos. With this, you can use it as a wonderful base and then add your SPF and makeup so its a versatile option. The smell is amazing - juicy, but not perfumey or fake - just smells natural and like watermelon. Texture is like a gel but it absorbs really quickly into the skin. It does not leave my skin feeling super dewy/moisturized in an oily way, just a nice barely there satisfying way...if that makes sense. The bottle seems to last me a while and I just repurchased another after about a year - I use about 2 pumps for my entire face/neck but I have alternated with another moisturizer for winter though. I have normal/combo skin and in the winter this is fine but I personally need a little more moisture, but it does its job and is WONDERFUL for summer/warmer months.

full_text: Perfect moisturizer for under makeup and SPF. I absolutely love this moisturizer. Some of you may think the downside here is there is no SPF but I consider this a plus. I kinda hate wearing moisturizer with SPF then a foundation or BB cream with even more SPF - it just seems necessary and sometimes it just creates too much of a film/gives flashback in photos. With this, you can use it as a wonderful base and then add your SPF and makeup so its a versatile option. The smell is amazing - juicy, but not perfumey or fake - just smells natural and like watermelon. Texture is like a gel but it absorbs really quickly into the skin. It does not leave my skin feeling super dewy/moisturized in an oily way, just a nice barely there satisfying way...if that makes sense. The bottle seems to last me a while and I just repurchased another after about a year - I use about 2 pumps for my entire face/neck but I have alternated with another moisturizer for winter though. I have normal/combo skin and in the winter this is fine but I personally need a little more moisture, but it does its job and is WONDERFUL for summer/warmer months.

review_text: this is honestly my favorite moisturizer ever. it has more of a serum-like texture in my opinion, but amazing nonetheless. i don’t write reviews often, but after my repurchase i had to (i don’t tend to repurchase things because i like trying out new things once i use it up). i saw that others felt sticky after using it, and this sometimes happens when i put on a serum underneath it. however, on its own, i don’t find it sticky at all. the scent is very refreshing and light. not at all overpowering and it smells more natural than artificial. this is better for those with oily skin based on the fact that it’s a gel. i have combo skin and it works great on mine! i one time tried out another moisturizer for a bit and broke out. once i switched back my skin went back to normal (no pimples now!). i use 1 pump and pat it on to my face. it really helps with my redness as well. it’s very good at calming my skin down too. i use this morning and night alongside glow recipe’s blueberry bounce cleanser. this product worked really well for me and i hope it does for you too!

review_text: I was very hesitant on buying this as I get so anxious trying new products. I have pretty sensitive skin and I have been normally using the Belif creams for moisturizer but was getting a bit bored of my skin care ritual & wanted to shake things up. I really do love Glow Recipes packaging- it’s always good quality and sturdy, lotions come with pumps that don’t quit on you so that’s a bonus! The scent is beautiful, it’s a very light watermelon whiff- perfect to wake yourself up on a summer morning. The lotion is very light and a little goes a long way. It doesn’t leave an oily feeling and it’s not a thick lotion so it doesn’t feel heavy. However, after you first apply it, it does seem to stay a bit “tacky” on the skin, almost sticky. That does go away as it absorbs into the skin & I personally only use it at nighttime, but if you were using it in the morning you’d want to wait about 10 minutes before applying primer or makeup on top of this. review_text: Full disclosure: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for review. However, whether a product is gifted or personally purchased by myself, I always give my honest thoughts. This is a moisturizing serum that comes in a glass bottle with pump dispenser. I love the minimalistic, pastel aesthetic. It is cute, but still elegant enough for any age. The color is a light pink and the serum has a watermelon scent that isn’t overly sweet or heavy.  After cleanser and toning, I use two pumps to apply to my face. The texture is smooth, spreads easily, and my skin absorbed it quickly.  It was hydrating to my skin without leaving a tacky residue or sitting heavy.  Depending on how dry my skin is on a particular day, I may or may not use an additional cream moisturizer on top of the serum. If I do, it’s usually in the evening. During the day, I like this alone because it was a good base for when I used makeup. It applied well to my skin by gliding over and not getting patchy from stickiness or pilling. I think this would be good for most skin types.  My skin has some sensitivities, and I would describe it as combo as I get a bit oily around my nose or chin. It does gets drier during the winter, so I this is better for the summer months for me. I noticed no negative effects while using this serum. No redness or congestion. Overall, I am very happy with my experience with this product, and would definitely recommend. The packaging is so cute, so I think this would make such a nice gift item for any beauty enthusiast.

review_text: To be honest, I never felt all that compelled to check out this brand, as I wasn’t sure if it was gimmicky, but frig how could I resist something called Watermelon Pink Glow Juice??? And then I looked at the ingredients and daaaaymn I’m impressed. The first two ingredients are Watermelon Fruit Extracts, so of course smells like watermelon and feels silky on the skin.I think the bulk of the appeal with this product is the sensorial experience you get, which is valid. There’s something to be said about skincare that you ENJOY using. All in all, this is a nice product that I think works best as an emulsion, or as a summertime moisturizer for those with oily skin. I enjoy its versatility and how it can be used as a moisturizer, serum, emulsion, makeup primer, or even added to your foundation. So in one way or another, it could work for almost any skin type.

I’m not sure bout the “tacky“ texture everyone else is mentioning, as I found the texture to feel like a typical serum. Overall, I give it an 8/10.

review_text: Tried a trial size of this that lasted about two weeks. My skin’s on the dryer side, so they have directions to use this as a serum for dry skin. I was not impressed. First off, for those with dry skin, you really should only use it as serum. It will not cut it as a moisturizer. It kind of just sits on top of the skin. It doesn’t really sink in. Even as a serum, I didn’t find it very helpful or that it made much difference. I used it with my moisturizer during the day, and at night I would just use moisturizer, and it felt pretty much the same.

review_text: I have used a Korean skin care routine for the last 3 years and it has made such a big difference in the tone, texture, and overall look and feel of my skin. I bought this moisturizer to try and I am not disappointed at all. I am in my 40’s and it is not too heavy or too light of a moisturizer. It is frankly just right as far as hydration. I have very sensitive skin and this moisturizer does amazingly well. I put it on in the morning before my makeup application and it helps to even out the application. I do not feel any residue at all once the moisturizer dries. So comments are that it is sticky once applied, that is only while it is drying. There is no residual stickiness and greasiness once done. This is a very light moisturizer and I use another step in my routine at night and as well as an essence to ensure that this maximizes this step’s effectiveness. I really like smell of fresh watermelon, yet the fragrance is very light. It dissipates once you are done using it. The packaging is simple, yet pretty. I feel like my skin is not stripped after cleansing and this little number ensures that.

review_text: My skin is the oilyest of oily. I used to get those blotter sheets as a teenager and could use a whole pack in a few days. My skin has calmed way the heck down since then, thanks to Niaminicide and chemical exfoliants, but my skin still is oily always. So finding a moisturizer that won’t make me breakout is a feat in and of itself. This moisturizer is not as light as a gel cream is, but it has benefits and key ingredients those don’t have. It’s ever so slightly heavier than a gel cream, so much so that you probably won’t even notice. It’s formulated so well it can be used at night to keep your skin hydrated. I am trying gel creams out now, but I don’t think I will find anything to replace this moisturizer.

review_text: What a beautiful product; I am in love with it! Everything about the C-Rush Gel Crème is elegant and beautiful, and I have such a lovely time using it. The packaging, for starters, is joyful and classy, as the glass is matte, and embodies a high-end, refined aesthetic. The cream itself is lightweight, smells LIKE DESSERT (seriously,) and imparts a beautiful, radiant glow to your skin. I would recommend this to combination or oily skinned individuals, as the crème may be a little too light for dry skin (if using it for its moisturizing properties.) The only thing I don’t care for is the fact that one of its ingredients is Phenoxyethanol, which rates as a 4 (moderate hazard) on EWG’s website. However, I am kind of a “natural ingredient freak,“ and given the debate about the aforementioned ingredient, I believe the benefits of this product outweigh the potential risk.I did receive this product as a free sample, but all opinions are my own. I recommend this gorgeous product to anyone looking for a little “oomph“ in their skincare routine.

I think it’s best used by itself on a makeup free day for that radiant healthy skin glow. My t-zone tends to get oily, so under make up I found my face to be oily in that area after a couple hours, but is really great for any dry patches. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes and really glad that I did. I will definitely be purchasing this again!

review_text: I love this product. I was sent this for free to review and was definitely going in rather skeptical. However, it is a great product. It feels lightweight on the skin, never leaving a heavy or tacky residue. It sinks into the skin quickly and is easy to apply. After using it for a week, I notice a big difference in my skin. My skin is soft even on cold days, windy days, dry days, etc. The only complaint I have is that it does have a potent smell that is akin to chemicals and citrus. You get used to it after the first couple of uses and once you start rubbing it into your skin, the scent decreases into a more pleasant one, but it can be a bit of a shock when you first open it. Definitely a great product worth every penny!

review_text: I have “normal skin“ (neither too oily or dry) and have been using this facial creme for 3 weeks. The consistency of the product is creamy yet not too thick, and it absorbs well into the skin. It is highly fragrant, smelling like an orange creamsicle. I find the smell pleasant, but people who are sensitive to smell may find it overwhelming. This does not have SPF, so I have to use this in combination with another product for sun protection. It sits well underneath makeup moisturizes my skin well. I do find that later in the day, my skin is more oily than when I don’t use this product. However, I have not experienced any breakouts from this product. I did receive this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

review_text: This is my new favorite face crème, hands down. I have tried many different moisturizers from many different brands (expensive, and drugstore)... and I have to say, this moisturizer blows them all out of the water. When I opened this product for the first time, the smell and texture were so intriguing. This product has an energizing and invigorating, citrus scent to it, but doesn’t smell like straight up orange zest (which I like). Also, this crème has a lightweight consistency, which when massaging it into the skin, feels hydrating, yet subtle on the skin.Since using this crème, I have noticed a major difference in my skin. My face feels softer, smoother and more plump. My skin also has more glow to it and is brighter and more healthy. I love to use this crème at night after I have washed my makeup off from the day. When I wake up in the morning my complexion looks more even. My face feels fresh, hydrated and looks dewy. I also like to use this crème after I exfoliate and before I apply my makeup. I have found that this is the perfect primer. The peachy color of this product acts as a color corrector to counteract darkness and unevenness and to brighten the skin. After applying this crème, then foundation, I have noticed that my face is so glowy and radiant.I would recommend this product for any skin type because it is hydrating, yet light (but I have normal/combination skin for reference). I also received this product complimentary for testing and sampling purposes. Everything stated above is based on my own personal experience with this product.

review_text: I have been using this product for about two month now every morning along with my regular skin care routine. Overall, this product does what it tells you it’ll do but did not truly blow me away after extended use. It definitely hydrates my skin and the product’s smell is fabulous, but it sits somewhat heavy and sticky. Eventually the feeling goes away, but when the summer days grow hot you want a moisturizer that feels cool, light and airy upon application. Besides those improvements, the product did not seem to clog my pores or cause breakouts, and did moisture my skin quite well with a lovely dreamsicle  smell. As for tone, I did not see much of a change if any at all. Overall: did what it said it would, sat a bit heavy/sticky, smelt fabulous, may recommend

review_text: I took Sephora’s skin quiz. This was one of the products recommended to me. I looked at the rating...yup, pretty good ones. Yet, this product did not work for my oily skin. review_text: I got this moisturizer about a week ago and have been using it every day, twice a day. review_text: I received this product from Influenster and was extremely excited. Olehenriksen is a great brand but unfortunately this product isn’t for me. First if you’re scent sensitive this smells very much like a Creamsicle. Smells rarely bother me but it is extremely strong and cloying  and the smell lingers. However, I didn’t let that stop me from trying the product. I added this product to my routine for three weeks, it was great timing, it’s a very heavy moisturizer and we had a cold snap where I live so my skin was dryer than normal. Unfortunately, I quick received one of the worst breakouts I have in quite some time and stopped using the product after week three after only getting worse. Having removed it from my routine my skin is improving again. My skin is normally not sensitive so I was surprised by this but recommend just starting with a sample, like I recommend with most skin care products as everyone’s skin reacts differently to different products. This most likely would work best for mature skin and dry skin.

review_text: I really want to love this product but the results are inconsistent. It’s a good moisturizer that feels thick and soothing but is really quite lightweight since it absorbs so quickly into the skin. I used the mini size for a month and it worked amazing on my sensitive, acne prone skin. However, after I started using this larger size, I started breaking out instantly. I thought I might have been something else so I kept using it. But now it’s been about a month using it and my skin is only getting worse and I can’t think of what else has changed. I can’t be certain it’s this cream, but I’m wondering if I got a bad batch or if there was a formulation change. With such an expensive cream, I don’t want to take my chances, so I will likely be returning. For those willing to take the chance, I’d recommend it for people who have oily or normal skin and like the feeling of a rich product but find that most rich creams are too heavy. For dry skin, this might not be heavy enough.

review_text: I really like YTTP’s other products and I got this as part of a free sample. I have mild rosacea and started using this at the beginning of a flare up. I also have some areas of dry skin, but some areas that are oily. I was really surprised at the texture of this. It’s thick and creamy, but is actually light going on the skin. It soaked in really well and left my skin super soft and actually comfortable amidst the red, heat, and itchyness I was experiencing. It was more soothing than I anticipated. In the morning my face was still really soft and not oily at all, which can happen with some moisturizers. After a few days, I can say that I definitely like this and it has helped soothe my skin while providing needed moisture. Like all YTTP products, there is a light scent that isn’t overpowering and doesn’t linger. It’s a bit earthy though and not as fresh as their other products. I like pairing this with the hydrating mist and superfood cleanser. Will continue to use and highly recommend for sensitive skin.

review_text: I didn’t want to believe this was causing me to have horrible breakouts because I just loved how it was moisturizing without making my skin feel greasy. It dries down into a moisturized matte kind of feeling which is great. The effect on my skin was really odd though. I know I have sensitive super acne prone skin so I’m very careful to read ingredient labels before I buy. This seemed like a winner. It did seem to make my skin seem brighter and more even tone somehow, but caused a lot of pimples with a keratin type plug in the middle. I used it for 2-3 months but recently started using my old sensitive skin lighter moisturizer since its warm out & all of my acne cleared up. It’s that time of the month too so typically (since i’ve been using this moisturizer) my face would be exploding with pimples- but its mostly clear. The only thing I changed in my routine was switching out moisturizers. I’m really sad about it & if you aren’t so acne prone you’d probably love this.

review_text: To start, I have fairly dry skin. I don’t have the driest skin, as in my skin does not flake and doesn’t feel super rough. But, my skin is very, VERY dehydrated. So even the most rich and moisturizing creams leave my face feeling tight, though it’s literally slathered in moisture. This is the holy grail. I know it’s spendy. But when I tell you I have tried every moisturizer in the book and this gets it done. Usually I have to apply 2-3 thick layers of moisturizer so my face can feel normal-ish. This just takes one, regular layer. It feels so smooth to apply on my skin, almost like butter. My skin TRULY drinks this up. It doesn’t just sink into my skin and technically provide moisture, it completely melts into my skin and rehydrates every pore and patch. The tight, parched feeling is instantly gone after application. After a few seconds my skin feels noticeably more plump and bouncy. Since I also have very fair skin, my blotchy redness always comes through, but since using this daily I have seen a dramatic reduction in my redness. My skin is so glowing and even. For reference, I use their kale cleanser and their kombucha exfoliant as well. This combo leaves my skin literally transformed. I’ll attach a before and after photo from using just those products, as well as occasionally using the mask of Magnaminty from Lush. That’s it. As much as my college student budget hates spending nearly $60 on a moisturizer, there’s simply not another moisturizer that can get the job done. Invest in this!! I’ll attach a before and after below.

review_text: This stuff is awesome! Out of countless creams, serums, and masks at every price point that I’ve tried over the years to get a handle on the blotchy redness on my face and upper chest, this is the only one that had [nearly immediate] results. Calming indeed! I have lupus with the characteristic “butterfly“ rash across my cheeks as well as a permanently flushed upper chest, and sun damage hyperpigmentation all over, too. It doesn’t seem to be curative (which I hadn’t expected), but it does prove to alleviate the redness for at least 8-10 hours. My skin tone is far more even, and my makeup looks fantastic now. It plays well with other skin care and makeup - No pilling or gross texture/residue, nor does it make makeup look cakey. It’s very hydrating and no scent. Absorbs nicely. I wish it came in a bigger jar because I use it twice a day, including on my neck and chest. It’s not obnoxiously expensive, which is great. Very happy to have finally found something that works - all the others I’d tried were nothing more than ridiculously over priced snake oils.

review_text: Somewhere in my 30’s I developed sensitivity and allergic reactions to most moisturizers and sunscreens and went without for many years.  I discovered YTTP last year and have been obsessed with their Superfood Air-Whip Moisture Cream ever since. I was sent this moisture cream to be used in combination with the Adaptogen Soothe   Hydrate Activated Mist with Reishi   Ashwagandha and asked for a review. After 2 weeks of use, I’m happy to report that they did not cause any sensitivity or allergic reactions. I did notice that the combination does have a slight woodsy nature smell to them despite being fragrance free. Overall, I’m happy with the product and my skin feels great but I don’t notice any difference in my skin using these products than when I was using my other YTTP cream. And now that I see that each product is to be purchased individually, that would most likely dissuade me from purchasing these both.

review_text: So, I’m on my second jar and I think my search for a staple moisturizer is over! I love that this is advertised for sensitive and reactive skin because my skin does not freak out with this product at all. No matter how many serums or actives I use with this moisturizer, my skin is always cool, calm, and collected lol. It has never broken me out or caused blackheads. I love that it doesn’t have dimethicone and it feels so light on the skin. I feel moisturized when I wear it and that my skin can breathe at the same time. And when I say my skin can breathe I mean when I put on the moisturizer I don’t immediately start sweating because my pores are blocked. (People who tend to run a little hot know exactly what I mean lol) I have noticed that on super dry days I do need a couple drops of oil but I don’t mind adding a little oil for those moments. If you have super dry skin, this may not be enough moisture for you on its on. But if you have dry and acne prone skin, I think this would be perfect for you. And if you have oily skin, you may like it as well because it’s very light. Yes it’s pricey but when you find a product that works so well with your skin sometimes is worth spending the money. And it’s definitely worth it for me.

review_text: I wanted to love this product but unfortunately, it made me break out. I tried this moisturizer for almost 2 weeks and I loved the consistency and the way my skin felt after I put it on. I again tried the moisturizer for a few days and the bumps returned. This was surprising to me because I don’t have sensitive skin and I never react badly to products. Ultimately, I think this is a good product and I wish it had worked for me. I think it would be better for someone with more of a normal to dry skin type, it has a great texture and feels good on the skin. I especially love the fact it is vegan! But sadly it just didn’t work for my oily & acne prone skin.

review_text: Wanted to love this moisturizer given the glowing reviews. When I first bought this, my face was feeling a little dry. Although the texture of this cream is very rich, I never felt like my face was getting enough hydration, especially overnight. Still, I wanted to use the whole jar before passing judgment. Flash forward three months and my usually smooth skin is greasy and breaking out like a teenage boy’s. I feel like the lack of hydration sent my oil production into overdrive, and now I have deep acne and noticeable blackheads where I’ve never had them before. Looking at the ingredients now, Octyl Palmitate is very comedogenic and third on the list. I wish this had provided more of the hydration it claimed it would instead of pore-clogging palm oil derivatives.

I’ve actually never had such amazing results from a product so quickly. Yay!

review_text: I didn’t know what to expect from this cream. The Charlotte Tilbury brand is predominantly known for makeup. This is a pretty awesome moisturizer...especially during these winter months. I have combo/oily skin that really takes a hit during colder months. I tend to layer various products in my skincare routine so I usually look for lighter/thinner formulas for this. I love to use the magic cream as my final abs occlusive later to seal everything in and give my skin and radiance and smooth base over which to apply my makeup. Holy glow!  This really makes the skin beam without looking oily or slick. On lazy days, I’ve used just the magic cream and have still been left with soft and supple skin. Sinks in deep to keep you moisturized, the magic cream has always played well with both liquid and powder makeups.  It is pretty heavily scented but that did dissipate throughout the day. Love the glow this gives!

The packaging is beautiful with it’s sturdy glass jar and gold lid and I love that it contains ingredients such as hyaluronic acid and vitamins c, e, and bionymph peptides which are supposed to aid in hydration as well as skin health such as smoothness and wrinkles. However, it did the opposite for me. The cream has a thicker texture almost like sunscreen which left my skin with a slight greasy feeling that never fully absorbed no matter the amount applied. The overall results left my skin with breakouts and feeling very dry which became worst with continued use. With that said, it just was not right for my skin.

review_text: I started using this after beginning treatment for acne at a dermatology clinic so I wasn’t sure how this would work for my combination skin that tends to run on the oily side. For reference, I was using clindamycin gel and tretinoin. So I needed good moisturizer to help counter the drying retinoid. As soon as I apply this cream after patch testing to be sure I didn’t have any reactions, I was pleasantly surprised by how it just sank into my skin and felt so light. I’ve been using it for a month and my skin has just been so soft ever since starting.I continued using this product for about a month and it has been such a surprise because my skin has just been so soft ever since I started using it. Sometimes the tretinoin dries me out a bit but then this helps me get back to a more balanced skin. The hyaluronic acid and peptides are ingredients I look for and even though this moisturizer has oils and I sometimes avoid them, it’s just felt so light and I’ve had no issues.The moisturizer does have a floral scent, which I love, but if you’re not into florals you might want to get a sample first.On my skin this can also serves as my primer. I don’t feel like I need an extra primer before makeup application.

review_text: I use highly hydrating cream/serum after chemical peeling when my skin gets very dry and patchy. DRUNK ELEPHANT Protini Polypeptide Moisturizer is the best so far. I used Marc Jacobs Shameless foundation with Marc Jacobs Coconut Primer, but the cream was too greasy and foundation and concealer did not stay beautifully as usual. Next time, I skipped the primer and used the liquid foundation directly after using the magic cream. Still felt greasy. I used silicon primer, not the Marc Jacobs Coconut Primer, but still felt greasy. Only thing I can think of is that maybe this magic cream is good with cream foundation? Something with a thicker consistency like stick foundation?I love CHARLOTTE TILBURY’s makeup products. I really tried to love this cream. That’s why I used this cream in many different ways. But after all, I didn’t like its functionality nor the feel of using it.

review_text: Unexpectedly great until you consider the price tag. I cashed in on my rewards and tried this because of the hype. My expectations were quite low, and I was pleasantly surprised by this cream! Rich but not too rich and leaves my face feeling well moisturized. I wore this under make-up without a problem--it doesn’t feel too heavy. Worth mentioning that it didn’t break me out, and I do have acne-prone skin. My biggest complaints: the hefty price tag, which, as far as I’m concerned, isn’t justified considering the ingredients; and the slightly odd texture of the cream. I’m not sure if I got a bad batch or something happened to the consistency during shipment, but it has solidified to a mostly shea butter texture (I was expecting a more whipped, mousse-like texture). If this were an affordable drugstore cream, I wouldn’t really care one way or the other about consistency. Overall, I’d recommend but I’m sure there are similarly formulated and much more affordable creams out there (if attached to a slightly less glamorous brand).

review_text: I purchased this moisturizer along with three other products to combat fine lines and extremely dry, flakey skin I developed while pregnant. I never saw any significant results to be honest and so I switched to the Versed moisturizer after I was about 90% done with the product.  Since switching I’ve seen a MASSIVE difference in my skin, no more flaking, fine lines have faded, brighter complexion to name a few changes.  However I didn’t immediately place blame on the Magic Cream as I had introduced a lot of other products into my routine. I ran out of the Versed one and began using what I had leftover from the CT and this is what compelled me to write this review. With only 3 days of use, dry and flaking patches have returned all over my cheeks and forehead and a bumpy texture has developed on my cheeks. This is the only thing that has changed in my routine in the past 3 days. I am now convinced that this cream does less than nothing for $100. Save your money and your skin and invest elsewhere as I am sure now more than ever you are paying for packaging and certainly not a product that does anything is claims to - not even at a minimum does it moisturize

Then when I do use a sponge it still pills along my jaw line so I take a large fluffy brush with nothing on it and I sweep away any pills. Why do I love it? If you have oily skin or you still get acne I wouldn’t buy it.

review_text: I know this isn’t one of the “clean” products, and it’s not advertised as being for sensitive skin—and I even saw one of the reviews pointing out that it has unlabeled sunscreen ingredients, which is true (look it up on incidecoder! Literally 4 ingredients whose only known purpose is as chemical sunscreens—and not the kind that’s reef-safe or legal in HI either, which might be the only explanation I can imagine, since it was apparently developed for models… who might spend a lot of time in places like HI… maybe that’s the “magic”??)! And yet… I’ve been combating insanely sensitive skin since moving to the horrifically dry CO climate 2.5 years ago. Like complete face broken out in a solid bumpy, painful hivey rash at least 3-5 days/week. Zoom filters couldn’t cover it up. And somehow, this perfumed, chemical sunscreen ridden moisturizer is literally the first product I’ve found that actually managed to not set off a reaction—including every one of the top “clean” brands and sensitive skin products I’ve tried.  For reference, I made Sephora Rouge status over the course of about 5 months last year—I am NOT kidding around when I say I’ve tried pretty much every facial moisturizer/soother/serum/oil/etc they’ve offered through the bazaar, boxes, samples, mini/travel sizes, or even sold as full size for less than like $80–that’s a lot of products, folks. I was even doing controlled tests for months (different products on different parts of my face, product-free control zone, the whole works) after I first tried it, and it visibly and immediately soothed my skin unlike anything I’ve tried so far. I’ve been using it on its own for the last month or so, and haven’t had a single flare—by far the longest I’ve gone in over two years. I do think it’s on the heavy side for summer, but it absorbs really well. If I can find something else without the secret sunscreen, I’d love to use it—but until then, I’ll just say that “clean” skincare isn’t always the solution for reactive skin.

review_text: This product is NOT gluten free as it claims. Sephora needs to be more careful when listing products as gluten free. Many people have a GLUTEN ALLERGY and Sephora just lists oats in ingredients like it’s not a lawsuit waiting to happen. If anyone has serious issues w gluten then do not use this product. It is NOT GLUTEN FREE and is not safe. (Oats are never gluten free, they can try to filter the gluten out but there’s always the 20ppm that still make people seriously sick). Always check the ingredients folks.

review_text: I have purchased this every winter for the past 5 years, and will purchase it again the end of October. I have very sensitive, very dry, mature skin, plus the winters here are long and ridiculously cold (-20°F at times for weeks). The texture and smell of this cream is amazing and so luxurious. It is the perfect amount of moisturizer for me—it’s not greasy at all. I have tried a lot of luxury skincare before and this is the only one I’ve tried where the price seems justified. This year, though, I have rosacea, so I’m hoping I don’t have any sort of adverse reaction, as I have had to several products I used over the summer. This is also the day Cream, but it’s so heavy I only use it at night. After 30 days of use my skin glows and loses the texture and dry patches on my face. I’m not sure why I don’t use this year round, but it is expensive and I like to try new products. It’s definitely worth the winter buy for me—one jar will last 4-5 months. Definitely a good choice for dry, aging skin! You will see results after a month!

review_text: I received this product as a free sample. This product is a lot thicker than I expected! It has such a rich consistency which means a little goes a long way. Despite the thick texture, it does spread and absorb very quickly. It leaves the skin feeling baby soft, with a natural finish. Not dewy, not matte. It has the slightest hint of fragrance (rose, I think) but its pleasant and doesn’t bother me one bit. Best of all it doesn’t pill with my other products. I did try it alone and found that it works for most of my face but doesn’t quite provide enough moisture for my dry patches (due to dry skin and tretinoin). I don’t blame the product one bit as there isn’t anything on the market that can single-handedly tackle my dry patches. I was perhaps most impressed by how well this helped fill in the larger pores on my cheeks. I usually always go in with a pore primer but this product gave my expensive primer a run for it’s money. This would help me slightly justify the price of the product in the future. We love a multi purpose product! If there truly are enough peptides, vitamin c, and hyaluronic acid in this formulation, it could be considered a 4 in 1. Still, I have to deduct one star because of the price to oz ratio. I fear I’ll go through this jar fairly quickly and struggle to fit into my beauty budget on a regular basis…But if you have the financial means, love a product that does what it says while looking absolutely beautiful on your vanity at the same time, give this a try!

review_text: I love this cream. It has a smooth, creamy texture to it and a luxurious feel. I have Normal skin and it hydrates my skin perfectly without making me oily or greasy or too dry. For me, it gives just the right amount of hydration but I have been told that I have normal skin. If you have skin that is either super oily or super dry, you might need to use a different cream. It is expensive, but a little goes a long way. I do think that a fragrance free version might benefit some people better. There is fragrance in this, and I don’t mind the smell at all but I have super bad allergies in the summertime and it does make me sneeze a little. My skin is softer, smoother and more supple after using this. I bought this cream for line & wrinkle prevention though and I wish I could tell if it really helps with that. I’m in my mid 20’s with no *current* wrinkles but I do want a lot of aging prevention. There’s no existing lines on my face to diminish or make disappear, so (it’s hard to tell if it will help with that, I can’t see any before & after because there were no wrinkles to start with) I really do hope that it actually helps with that. But everything I’ve seen with my skin since using this has been positive, and it feels amazing (looking forward to moisturizing everyday) so I will continue to use it and re-buy. I’ve also tried a variety of mid range to expensive creams on the market, if that helps anyone, and I still feel that this is a good cream. I’d love to see photos of it truly helping diminish & prevent wrinkles though, since that is my main concern.

review_text: I’ve heard countless people rave about this cream for years now, to the point that when I finally got to try it out myself, I was almost skeptical about it living up to the hype - in my experience, many “cult favorite“ products end up inevitably being at least a bit (if not more) underwhelming because it creates unrealistic expectations. That said, I stand corrected because it’s TOTALLY WORTH THE HYPE!!!! My skin felt amazing as soon as I applied it, and I woke up the next morning with insanely soft skin! I forgot to take before-and-after photos of the line/wrinkle on my upper forehead, so I can’t say with absolute certainly whether or not there was a visible difference, but it definitely firms/plumps skin. I’ve mostly used this as a night cream rather than a base/primer for makeup, but given the lightweight yet rich texture, I can see it working well under foundations, especially medium/full coverage ones. FYI, a little goes a long way, and even though it sinks in quickly, I’d recommend applying a smaller amount to start and then add more as/if needed.

review_text: I purchased the full size immediately after using a sample. When I first tried it, I loved it; felt creamy but not greasy, I loved the fact I didn’t need a separate eye cream (depending on ingredient list some moisturizers can’t be used on the under eye area), and although it was scented it wasn’t offensive or too strong. Makeup also applies really nicely over this and I didn’t find the need to use a primer. All that being said, I wouldn’t repurchase. It had no lasting effects, and although the bottle is beautiful you’re not getting very much product at this price point. review_text: I have been eye balling this stuff for a LONG TIME! Here are my takeaways. First off, the packaging is GORGEOUS! Came in a cute box that unfolded and had instructions on the flap. The smell was a very subtle, yet refreshing scent. Not an over the top perfume smell, which I appreciated. The texture was definitely creamy and soft. The instructions state you can wear alone or with makeup. I applied the cream on my cheeks for a contour, forehead, neck and jaw line. It definitely has a bit of a glow to it for a dewy look without makeup. Me, however, I have to wear makeup because of my hyperpigmentation and acne scarring. Plus I have oily skin so the no makeup, dewy look was NOT happening for me. I did, however, LOVE the way it made my face look after I applied my foundation and contour. The areas I applied the cream really helped my makeup glide on beautifully. I could tell my face looked brighter, there was the slight appearance of a lift in my contoured areas. I really liked the overall appearance. I was nervous it would make me oily throughout the day but it didn’t. It was  no different than normal. The one thing that did bother me was how my face felt a little thick throughout the day. I did feel like I was wearing a pound of makeup and I didn’t know if it was because I’d put too much on. The next day I wasn’t as liberal and my face felt a lot less thick. So with that being said, a little goes a long way. The price point is pretty good considering you don’t need to use that much so it will last awhile. I love the glow it gives me and will continue to use to help enhance my features and brighten my complexion.

review_text: This product was included in a Biossance set I purchased and I was really disappointed with this product. Even though it claims to be good for all skin types I think this product is definitely better suited for dry skin types because the product sat on top of my skin for far too long after massaging it into my face for quite a bit of time.  I started breaking out (not acne just mild irritation) at some point when using this product and now that I’ve stopped using it my skin is back to normal.  Would only recommend to people with super dehydrated skin.

review_text: Let me start off by saying I have pretty dry skin. I always have to wear moisturizer, day and night. I like really thick moisturizers that almost leave my skin greasy. My to go is either Cetaphil or CeraVe and I lather this all over my face.With that said, this moisturizer is pretty thick. I usually go to sleep feeling super moisturized. However, I noticed that I wake up in the morning with my face feeling tight and dry. I’m not sure why. I am applying a good amount to my face. However, when I apply this moisturizer in the day time, it’s the perfect amount of moisture. I’m going to keep trying it out to see if my face adapts to it at night. Also, another con is the smell. I’m not sure why the product smells the way it does. It’s not a very pleasant smell. However, i would rather take this smell over products that smell too good. I think that’s a sign that chemicals have been used.All in all, I would say I like this moisturizer so far. Aside from my face feeling tight in the morning, my complexion looks bright and glowing. It really soaks into my skin. I love how incredibly safe their products are for the environment and our skin. I mean their squalane is 100% plant based!

review_text: I wanted to use this cream for a while before leaving a review, and now that I just finished my first jar I can honestly say it is the best facial cream I’ve used to date. It’s lightweight yet creamy, absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave my face greasy. I have a dry skin and this winter has certainly not been kind (polar vortex anyone?) I was using DE cream for several months but as the air got drier, so as my face and DE cream was no longer able to keep my skin moisturized. After my own intense research of “clean” products I decided to give this one a shot. I know the price will make you cringe and cry for a week, but honestly it’s worth every penny. My boyfriend always comments on how soft my face is, and this is the only thing that I changed in my daily facial routine. I saw some reviewers mentioning of bad scent. I really don’t know what they’re talking about because this product virtually has no scent. It has a very light “natural” odor which one can expect in every product that is fragrance-free, but I only smell it when I actually stick my nose in the jar. I’m picky with scents and since I have a sensitive skin I’m always in search of unscented products. This product doesn’t bother me at all (unlike unrefined shea butter whose earthy scent hits you the moment you pop off the lid). Already purchased a second jar. Highly recommend!

review_text: So far I really like this. I have combination dry skin- oily at my temples and along my jawline with super dry skin in my t-zone. I was using a different night cream, but I live in a place with constantly changing weather that has wreaked havoc on my skin. I started peeling and got very dry and extremely itchy. I bought this on the recommendation from an in store employee and it offered immediate relief. I’ve used it for a few days and while a minimal amount of peel is left on my skin, my face feels much more hydrated and quite soft. Yes, there is a little bit of a smell that I really don’t like. However, the cream doesn’t have much of an odor just sitting in the jar unless you hold it right up to your nose and it goes away within a second or two once it’s rubbed in to your skin. It is ultra rich though, so be prepared when you apply it. For me personally, this is definitely not a cream I would want to apply in the morning under makeup. It’s way too heavy. But as a night time treatment, it’s really, really good. A little goes a long way with this one. Take the advice from other reviewers and start with a small amount and add more later. Because I haven’t used this for long enough, I don’t know what it really will do for fine lines and wrinkles, but the significant boost in hydration is definitely enough to warrant five stars, even with the odd smell.

review_text: This is an amazing moisturizer!I don’t normally use exclamation points but this product is worth it. I mainly use this product as a nighttime moisturizer, after I apply either the Biossance Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Oil or the Biossance Phyto-Retinol Serum. After I use it, I notice that my skin looks and sometimes feels renewed (“refreshed“ is impossible, without a latte macchiato in hand). It’s almost as like you wore highlighter to bed and it didn’t come off on the pillow, your skin looks dewy and feels hydrated after a hard night sleep.First, all you’ll need is 1-2 dime size dollops of the product, warmed up in your hands, and it smoothly glides across and nourishes every part of your face and neck. Using too much, it’ll start to feel heavy.Understandably, for some individuals this product will be too rich for their skin, this product is made for those with naturally dehydrated skin (like mine). It doesn’t always matter how much or how often you stay hydrated, sometimes your skin needs a little boost from your skincare routine. The omega fatty acids and hyaluronic acids in this product will do the exactly that, give your skin the boost it desperately needs. I cannot complain when I have an eczema flare-up either, it doesn’t irritate the outbreak spots at all. Seriously, my desert-skinned sisters, try it. Listen to your skin, be kind to your skin, love your skin.

review_text: I swear I’ve been using this for over a year and never noticed a smell, so all these reviews truly mystify me. I went back and checked and there is a slight smell, but it’s so very light, dissipates almost immediately and it’s not a bad smell! Honestly, I’ve been through a few jars of this by now and never would have even noticed a smell if I hadn’t read the reviews here.This is what a lot of fragrance-free beauty products smell like. But performance-wise....I have very dry, sensitive skin and I really like this cream, especially mixed with or layered with a nice oil (the Biossance Squalane or Rose Vit C oil, or Stratia’s Fortify oil or Drunk Elephant’s or the Ordinary’s marula oils are all great.) Or any nice squalane, marula, maracuja, argan, rosehip or jojoba oil would work, too. Also, just use a tiny bit of the oil if you try this method!Almost removed one star because occasionally this cream can make my skin sting very slightly for a few seconds. Not sure what’s in it that does that. It could be because my skin is just that sensitive, or it might be because it contains a small amount of hyaluronic acid (which sometimes makes my skin sting a bit). Only lasts for a few seconds, and the oils buffer it if you use them. And this cream really does seem to heal and hydrate my dry and sensitive skin. It’s a great barrier repair cream if used consistently. I’m not inspired to write many reviews, but this cream inspired me. Highly recommended!

review_text: I think I’ve finally found my holy grail moisturizer. Once I was a few months from hitting 25 and started noticing my face change I realized I needed to start taking care of my skin. I’ve found a good skincare regimen with a combination of The Ordinary and Herbivore products. However, the NYC winter air has been a little too much for my dry skin and I needed a more substantial moisturizer from a cream. I’ve tried a few samples from other cruelty-free brands at Sephora and none had really wowed me yet, but this did. I noticed pretty immediate help for the dryer spots of my face and moisture lasts all day without feeling greasy. It may be too much moisture for someone with Oily skin. It’s unscented so it has a slight fatty smell but it goes away almost immediately and I don’t really notice it. The smell is similar to Drunk Elephant’s La La cream but much less intense. You also don’t have to use a lot as it spreads really well and I appreciate that it will last longer than other brands with 50ML of product that are more expensive. Biossance is also an environmentally responsible company using renewable sugarcane for the squalene on top of being a cruelty-free company using good ingredients so it’s a win for me.

review_text: I really wanted to like this product. I’ve been on the hunt for a good moisturizer after switching from the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Cream (ingredients aren’t amazing). I searched the ingredients of this moisturizer on cosdna website, and I read and watched reviews. There is not a shortage of enthusiasm and support for the quality and effectiveness of this product, so I was hopeful. My skin is sensitive and on the dry side. I will say that this cream makes my skin feel soft to the touch, but I don’t exactly believe that it is very moisturizing or hydrating. It also leaves my face feeling slightly oily/greasy after application, to the point that it’s uncomfortable. I am used to the feeling of moisturizer and have never had this issue before. I actually had to blot my face after applying. The smell doesn’t bother me that much. Sometimes I felt like it smelled like cinnamon? I’ve been using it for a couple weeks and unfortunately I will be returning it because it has caused texture/tiny clogged pores on both of my cheeks. Wish it worked for me, but I’m definitely disappointed. Also, I agree with other reviews acknowledging the little amount of product you get for the price. I have only used this product for two weeks or so and the jar is more than half empty.

review_text: I’ve been using this cream for the last 3-4 months and won’t be stopping anytime soon! Between skin barrier issues and cold winters, I’ve needed a deep hydration cream with no actives and this has been perfect. This cream is incredibly hydrating without being too greasy, and leaves my skin looking plump, glowing, and healthy. I’m not sure what else to say, except that this is probably the best face cream I’ve tried and that I will be repurchasing despite the price and scent. Like others have mentioned, the product has a bit of a scent, likely due to the omega in it - I smell it while applying, but not afterwards/it does not linger. Given how the cream makes my skin look, it’s worth it to smell the oil for 30 seconds.

review_text: Before I go about my review, let me disclaimer this by saying that this product was sent to me for reviewing purposes so I’m going to give my honest opinion. I decided to test out the cream on the base of my neck to test out the product with my skin,  it was so soft! The next day, knowing that I didn’t get a reaction, I put it on my face. It felt very nice, not greasy, I used it in the evening because its fairly thick. I plan to try it under makeup one day, but have not yet. It does have a slight scent, but I stopped noticing it after a few minutes. So far so great, I hope I continue to see a difference.

review_text: So, also a part of my coveted, complimentary #springpicksvoxbox was an offering from @biossance : its Squalane + Omega Repair Cream. Now, I’ve got to say that I’ve never come across a Biossance product I didn’t adore before; truly, they usually work very well for me! So, I’m really sorry to say that I had some degree of difficulty even using this product. Outwardly, it looks promising: nice packaging, definitely a “creamy-cream,” and it’s from Biossance. That alone would likely get me to buy it if I were out at Sephora and in the market for a new cream. But if I did, I’d be disappointed. For me, I couldn’t get past the smell. Now, it’s advertised as unscented but I got a strong, almost-nostalgic smell of chlorine-mold-mildew-y pool deck at the local Water Park, and I think we all know what the kiddos do in the public pool at their discretion. I don’t know if it’s the squalane or what, but the smell is so off-putting it’s borderline offensive to the olfactory receptors. A hard (yet sorrowful) pass for me; maybe it’s a wonder cream and will work for others who can get past the smell.  2 out of 5 stars for being non-comedogenic and vegan.#complimentary #SpringPicksVoxBox #biossance #texturelove #MoroccanoilBody @Influenster @biossance @mizani @moroccanoil

review_text: I feel like the negative reviews are getting downvoted due to brand loyalty and I get it. Nearly every skincare product I own, is basically Tatcha. Most of their products are top notch. This cream is not the worst (im still using it, mixed with other stuff ) but its not good either. It just sits on the skin and it doesn’t absorb at all. I wake up with sticky face and it feels weird and oily. My dry skin needs something hydrating to penetrate it and this one just isn’t it. Im giving it more time. Its only been about a month of using it and I think it’s causing some breakouts but that could be hormonal too. Its awful under foundation because how it sits. Your make up will slide off and you’ll be a blotchy mess. My expectations from the brand are extremely high and this one was a fluke.

review_text: This is my nightly moisturizer as of late and will remain so until I finish it because I need extra hydration for my dry-leaning skin. I can’t and won’t do gel creams because they aren’t hydrating enough, so decided to get the limited edition 2.5 oz size. I either apply this on top of serum or mix it with a retinol serum product that’s oil-based. Either way, my skin is comforted and left cushiony soft and protected. Sometimes I’ll use this in the day and apply sunscreen then some bb cream, and my goodness, my skin is radiant and glowy. I really like this cream and am glad I finally decided to purchase after several years of eye-shopping it. Try it if you need extra moisture and want a dewy glow to your complexion.

review_text: I got the mini size on my birthday, and I’ve been using this almost every day and night as an eye cream. I know this is supposed to moisturize the face, but since I had very little, I tried to make the most of it. In the first 7 months, it did all the great things an eye cream was supposed to do: hydrating, lightweight, brightening, plump, and supple. So if you’re looking for an eye cream that’s not over $50, this could be it. The expiration date is 6 months, so I stopped using it on my face during the 8th month because it started to feel greasy and thick like the other reviews had said. Now, I just use what’s left of it on my hands as a second layer for the winter cold. I would give it a 4-star rating if it was used as an eye cream because it’s cost-effective and it works, but as a moisturizer, probably not.

review_text: I was surprised that this didn’t get a universal 5 stars in the ratings because this is hands down my favorite moisturizer. But when I looked into it, the complaints were from women who had acne issues. This is NOT a good moisturizer for acne prone skin.  However, it is AMAZING FOR DRY SKIN.  I have always been complimented for my beautiful skin, but that’s because I have always taken care of it. For years I used Chanel and LaMer products. At about age 45, I started using Clarins Double Serum (which I *still* swear by).  After trying a sample of Tatcha’s The Dewy Skin Cream, I realized that it worked just as well, but cost a fraction of what Chanel’s Le Lift or La Mer’s Creme de la Mer. I switched and haven’t looked back. I’m nearly 60 and I still have people compliment me on my beautiful skin and who are shocked when they hear my age. I have a simple routine: removing my eye makeup with Lancome’s Bi-facil, rinsing my face with water and a washcloth (and occasionally using micellar water), drying it and adding a small dollop of Clarin’s Double Serum, and in winter, following with this Tatcha moisturizer. My skin is reactive, tending to Rosaceae. I am very pale (Irish descent) and burn easily (followed by freckles). I also tend to have dry skin.

review_text: I LOVE Tatcha products so I was excited to try this. It is meant as a day cream to be put on before your makeup—it was designed in conjunction with a celebrity makeup artist. I have very dry, dehydrated, mature skin and love the Dewy Skin Mist and face mask so I was very excited to try this and eventually get the Dewy Night Cream for night. It has a pretty purple color and lovely, light scent. It goes on beautifully. Here’s where it doesn’t work for me: no matter what I put under it (vitamin C serum) or over it (Tatcha’s sunscreen or Camellia Oil) it PILLS. Even if I leave time for each thing to sink in, I still wind up with little balls Of product coming off my face if I touch it at all. I was really surprised this happened no matter what I put under or over it—even certain foundations I use will pill. If you only use a tiny amount, it will still pill if anything is put over it, so I’m guessing there is silicone in it. I have ended up using an entire jar, and I learned to use nothing else with it, but I need my other serums and oils, so it just didn’t work out for my needs. It’s a really nice moisturizer and feels luxurious, but the pilling drove me nuts. It’s also a heavy cream (that’s why you don’t need a lot) and feels heavy on the skin, and it does not dry quickly. An hour after using alone, it still feels heavy and not dry, even though it sinks in quickly. I’m sorry Tatcha—as much as I wanted to love this, it just didn’t work with my lifestyle and caused a lot of angst. If you use it alone, let it dry down for quite a while, and then apply makeup, it may work perfectly for you. I’m sorry it did not work for me. Now I’m hesitant about buying the night cream.

It’s amazing for dry skin as it’s super hydrating and definitely very dewy. I like using it at night as a good occlusive over skin care products but it also works well under more natural/matte fuller coverage foundations. You can really feel the silicone and the fragrance is definitely strong which is why I didn’t love it initially but neither have bothered my skin. I do feel like my skin looks nice and hydrated and plump in the morning which I don’t feel I get from many other moisturizers. Definitely going to repurchase with the next sale.

review_text: I purchased Tatcha The Dewy Skin Cream as a night cream at first. It is very hydrating and rather thick but it melts into my skin after a few minutes. The results are excellent. My skin was plump and refreshed the next morning. I sometimes add a face oil and mix The Dewy Skin Cream with my oil and then apply it on my face and neck at night. Being so impressed with this cream I started using it on mornings when I wanted that extra boost of hydration under my makeup. It is great under makeup as well. I highly recommend this moisturizer. I have combo normal to dry skin which is sensitive and this feels calming and hydrating. I will be continuing to use this in my daily skincare routine.

For as little as I use each night, I imagine this will last me a long time and it seems to have really turned my skin around.

It has a rich long lasting consistency (which we need when it’s 20 degrees outside), but doesn’t leave me with that oily feeling midday like most other skin creams.  This cream is excellent for holding that moisturized (dewy) look.  I use the dewy cream underneath the tatcha pore refining SPF.  Sometimes I add a little highlight on top and go foundation less or I can throw on a little primer and add a few drops of foundation on top as well.  I love makeup, but use a dime size amount of foundation.  Not sure how this would work underneath a heavy application of makeup.

review_text: Dewy Skin Cream is successful in creating a dewy complexion, but calling it a “cream“ feels almost misleading. It has the thickness of a cream, the weight of a balm, and the drag of a heavy, dry gel. My immediate thought was aerated (non-)petroleum jelly—it has its uses, but isn’t something I necessarily want on my face. While I can’t definitively identify the cream as the cause, I have experienced a mild breakout along the jaw and a looming, mid-face pimple (from someone who may get 2–3 per year, at best). I planned to use this product in the morning to take advantage of its cosmetic effects (and preferring something more “technical“ for sleep), but I have little desire wear it in any mix of heat or humidity, especially with sunscreen layered on. If used at night product, I’d suggest a generous time allowance for absorption before potentially touching face to pillow. I’ll try mixing sparingly with my preferred creams to make the texture palatable and maintain some of the effect, but Dewy Skin Cream is off the repurchase list. Beautifully packaged, unnecessarily fragranced.

review_text: I have been getting between 0-3 hours of sleep consecutively for the past week. I don’t recommend this in the slightest but I DO recommend this cream. In fact, I couldn’t recommend it more. Despite being severely sleep-deprived, I look like I’ve gotten 8 hours of sleep every day. Now by no means is this a free pass to skimp on sleep, but the fact that it is powerful enough to counteract the effects of my sleep deprivation is astonishing. Never before have I used a cream that made my skin show such visible improvement (with or without adequate sleep). All my friends have noticed the change since I started using it, and have shared their glowing (pun-intended) praise. If you’re looking for a dupe for this product to circumvent paying the hefty price, I’m sorry, but you just won’t find one. This stuff is the real deal and well worth the cost. Good news is, a little goes a long way. I’m two months into using this (I apply it every night) and I still have about a 1/3 left. I highly recommend this as an investment in your skincare routine.

review_text: I WANTED TO LOVE THIS SO BAD YALL!! I’m a Tatcha fanatic and use a good amount of her line in my everyday routine. Just to list them out: Cleansing Oil, Rice Polish, Essence, Water Cream, Pearl Eye Treatment, Firming Eye Serum, Brightening Serum, Silken Pore SPF, Silk Canvas Primer and Neck Cream. All that being said.. I have a pretty good understanding of the quality of Tatcha’s products are DEFINITELY worth the hype/splurge (scouts honor). Let me start off by saying I have Combo skin and to clarify.. I have oily t-zone, acne prone & my cheeks and nose are dry patch city if I use the wrong moisturizer. I used the Dewy Skin for a month and a half as my night time moisturizer before I realized we had to part ways *Sad Face*. Let me essplain... The first night after using the Dewy skin I immediately fell in love like all my other Tatcha skincare! My skin felt hydrated, refreshed and had a nice luminosity  but not greasy! So the next night was when it started going downhill... I woke up the next morning and saw these small skin colored bumps between the apples of my cheeks and my nostrils. Throughout the day.. the bumps would go away so I didn’t pay too much mind to it. Next day same bumps appeared in the same area AND on my forehead. But this time the we’re also a larger bumped joined in on the party. After switching back to my Water Cream as my morning and night time moisturizer.. I realized me and the Dewy skin couldn’t be pals anymore. All the bumps I experienced I’m suspecting they weren’t pimples but like temporarily/minorly clogged pores..?? Only because when I get a pimple/zip.. they stay for a really long time and then they leave a ridiculous scar forever! But the bumps would appear in the morning and sometime during the day! SO WEIRD!

review_text: I bought this wanting to love it because I love Tatcha! I have combo skin (oily t-zone and dry cheeks) and I read so many reviews stating this helped balance out their skin. I was excited to open it up and slather that pretty purple cream on my face, but that is the only good thing I have to say about it unfortunately. This just sat on my face and never really soaked in. I went to bed looking great and woke up feeling even greasier! I wanted this to work so I continued to use it and used less and less every night to the point where I was hardly using any, I still woke up looking like a grease ball every morning. After 5 days of use I started to get huge pimples on my checks and I looked greasy all day by the end of the week. I gave up and returned it and it took my skin a couple weeks to recover and return to normal.

review_text: I was recommended to get the Tacha Dewy Moisturizer and Rice Wash Cleanser by a Sephora employee for my skin type (combo-oily, super oily t-zone, dry patches on my cheeks and outer corners of my eyes). I first got the $25 travel set as a trial pack, and WOW did it have more product in it than I thought it would. The two tiny containers lasted me 3 weeks. More than enough time to see how my skin would handle the new skincare routine. I wash and moisturize my face twice a day and I’ve seen a tremendous improvement to my skin. I would have bright red breakouts on my chin, all over my jaw, cheeks, in between my eyebrows, my forehead and hairline. I have had a pimple maybe once in the past few weeks now? I do have scarring and some discoloration from years of picking at my poor skin—so I will be looking for a spot treatment for any pop-up zits and dark spots, BUT! I love this stuff. A little goes a long way and it’ll last you forever. The moisturizer smells good, has a nice feeling, dries quickly and has your skin feelings so incredibly soft. I was worried since this is a “dewy” moisturizer but I’m less oily after using this moisturizer than if I used an oil-free or gel based one as I have in the past. Nourishing and moisturizing without leaving your skin feeling oily or greasy. I’m just so happy I finally found something that worked! Totally worth the money, I buy this stuff maybe once every 2 or 3 months? Yes, it will last you that long. I just wanted to share in case someone also struggling with combo-oily, acne-prone skin was feeling iffy based on the reviews. Try the travel size! Your skin deserves it. <3

full_text: BEST CREAM EVER. BUY THIS NOW. I LOVE THIS CREAM. I have always wanted to try Tatcha, and this product was a great introductory item. My skin feels so plump and hydrated, but it’s not too heavy - which is super important to me because I have oily/combo skin. I honestly look forward to putting this cream on every morning and night, and I am dreading the day this runs out because I will totally have to purchase more!! Also the packaging and purple color cream is really cute. Lastly, I struggle with redness and uneven skin tone, and I’ll say that I do think the cream in combination with the Tatcha balancing toner are helping to reduce that.

review_text: I have oily skin normally but because of being home all day with the heating on it’s really taken a toll on my skin inside and out. My sister recommended this product and I am so in love. It feels refreshing when you apply it yet so moisturizing. I describe it as a quenching mountain breeze kissing your face. I was afraid of breaking out because I do have sensitive skin but my skin is actually the clearest and smoothest its been in a while. I also love how it leaves me with a fresh and clean glow after. Plus it smells divine! Not a strong fragrance though, just a subtle cooling scent which is not harsh on my sensitive skin. 10/10

review_text: I used to use FAB Ultra Repair Cream at night, I loved it for years. Then after I had my daughter, my skin completely changed, it became so sensitive and acne prone. My skin was itchy and red, so irritated. I washed, put this on and my skin said AAAAHH...thank you. So crazy. I guess I’ll never try and leave you ever again.

review_text: I’ve been using this for about two months now and I’ve had fantastic results. I typically have very dry flaky skin but recently I started using a topical retinoid that has made my skin even more dry and dehydrated. I got the mini size to try out and instantly loved it. It is very rich and heavy but dries down and doesn’t feel greasy at all. It has been amazing for my irritated skin barrier- no other product that I’ve tried in the past has even come close to this. It is now a staple in my nightly skincare routine and a must-have for anyone who has dry, dehydrated skin or a messed up skin barrier. I don’t usually use it in the mornings as it doesn’t work well with my sunscreen. My only complaint is that the pump dispenses MUCH more than you need-- if you apply the whole pump, the cream pills- especially if you have additional skincare steps after this one. You really don’t need that much of it. I use a hydrating mist (Cicapair or thermal spring water) before putting this on which I find also makes a huge difference and helps your skin soak it up. Definitely recommend.

review_text: As someone who is around 40, your facial moisturizer becomes VERY important to you. I used to regularly use Tatcha Dewy cream; which i always really liked despite the strong scent. However i received a sample of this with a purchase i got a few weeks ago. The sample was so small that i decided to just to use it on my under eye area. After a couple days the area under my eyes looked so moisturized and healthy and even a slight smile crease i had there became unnoticeable. I decided if it did this for my under eyes then i would take the chance and try it with my entire face. I ordered the regular size and i absolutely love it. It has made my skin feel and look better than it has in a long time. I use it twice a day. I guess this product just really vibes with me. This is now my permanent facial moisturizer as i have no need for anything more than it gives me. I still use this under my eyes whether that be right or wrong as i know products are made for specific under eye usage but this has turned mine around completely so I’ll keep doing what I’m doing. I like that it barely has a scent. It’s not greasy or shiny like Tatcha dewy cream yet my face has a healthy glow to it now. I would have much preferred a simple jar, rather than this double packed plastic bundle.  For a company reaching out to clean, vegan, cruelty free beauties, you definitely missed the mark on the packaging.   The pump is also very difficult to use, making it completely unnecessary.   I like the formula, but I would not purchase this as packaged.  It’s not easy to use, and it has a lot of waste.  I would reconsider having a simple jar.

review_text: I am so impressed with this cream. First of all, it’s formulated without fragrance, which is so unnecessary in any skincare. It also doesn’t have a bunch of fillers like silicones so you are really getting higher concentrations of hydrators and extracts. Also, it has one of the push applicators there release just the right amount of product which is way more hygienic than a tub and protects the actives in the formula from being oxidized early. I really appreciate how much thought skinfix puts into their formulations and packaging, and think this helps make the higher price point more reasonable. That being said, this is definitely on the pricier side. I do think it’s worth it, because a little goes a lot way, it’s super nourishing and you’re getting some really effective ingredients to support the skin barrier.

review_text: Although I think the quality of this product is good and actually works well, I am incredibly disappointed by how much plastic I am actually paying for vs the actual product. Why am I paying this much money for plastic? After dismantling the bottle with the help of my partner out of desperation for a few more drops I realized that the bottle seems to be filled with %60 percent plastic and %40 product, or perhaps less. I was actually infuriated. WHAT A RIP OFF!!! While the product is not bad and I would have considered using it again, I have to wonder what type of company does this? DO BETTER DRUNK ELEPHANT! I am disappointed and I will not be purchasing again.

I’d buy it again but would consider putting it in a different jar.

review_text: I’m surprised by the negative reviews this product has gotten since I’m now obsessed with it. I have dry skin (truly dry) all year long, and this is a lifesaver for me. This was recommended to me by a Sephora employee, who thought my other products I’ve used (Dr. Jart Ceramidin, Summer Fridays Jet Lag) were good choices, but this product beats them. My skin drinks this right up, and leaves me with incredibly soft baby skin. I also love the packaging from DE (the pump) and that even with all of the oils this doesn’t feel too heavy for my skin, even in the summer. I personally don’t notice a smell at all with this product, so I can’t comment on the neg reviews for that. I would highly recommend this product if you have dry skin like mine that needs a thicker moisturizer, otherwise try my other HG moisturizer, the Dr. Jart Ceramidin cream mentioned previously.

review_text: This product was my absolute BFF for my extremely dry skin throughout the winter.The ceramides and oils in it help with overall hydration, moisture barrier protection, and just keeping my skin happy.The dispenser, as in all of DE’s products, is one of my favorite things about this product. One pump and that’s all you need for your face. One more pump for your neck and décolletage. Bam! Done and you don’t waste any product.Downside to the way this product is packaged: can’t see when it is close to empty and sometimes there are air pockets within the cream which make the pump action kind of sputter; this leads you to thinking that you’re out. The weight of the product is arguably deceptive as well (unless you accurately weighed it new, converted the weight of 1.69 fl oz to grams, and then every time it sputtered you weighed it again to see if you were close to empty or actually at empty), as the mechanism for pumping is actually kind of heavy and the tub is double insulated -- which leads to imprecise “hand-weighing“.I’ve purchased Lala Retro 3 times, I believe, and only noticed these issues with weight and possible air bubbles vs. actually being empty with the most recent purchase. This leads me to wonder if I’ve accidentally thrown out precious, precious Lala cream before...At $1.2 per ml, this is actually one of the better deals you can get within the Drunk Elephant line, AND it is an excellent moisturizer. It also lasts a really long time, if you limit yourself to 1x/day applications, using only 1-2 pumps per day.I’m only giving it 4 stars because of the weight issue and because I have since found a cheaper moisturizer + facial oil combination which, total, is cheaper than just this one product and is as effective.I still love you DE.
