The weight of the product is arguably deceptive as well (unless you accurately weighed it new, converted the weight of 1.69 fl oz to grams, and then every time it sputtered you weighed it again to see if you were close to empty or actually at empty), as the mechanism for pumping is actually kind of heavy and the tub is double insulated -- which leads to imprecise “hand-weighing“.I’ve purchased Lala Retro 3 times, I believe, and only noticed these issues with weight and possible air bubbles vs. actually being empty with the most recent purchase. This leads me to wonder if I’ve accidentally thrown out precious, precious Lala cream before...At $1.2 per ml, this is actually one of the better deals you can get within the Drunk Elephant line, AND it is an excellent moisturizer. It also lasts a really long time, if you limit yourself to 1x/day applications, using only 1-2 pumps per day.I’m only giving it 4 stars because of the weight issue and because I have since found a cheaper moisturizer + facial oil combination which, total, is cheaper than just this one product and is as effective.I still love you DE.

review_text: I hate to say it, but I think this stuff is worth the price. This was the only moisturizer out of many that I had tried that really nourished my dry skin last winter (before the addition of the ceramides). I had to use a hydrating serum beforehand, but the combination was perfect. I tried substituting the Sephora brand cream that all the reviews claimed was a dupe for this, but it’s not even close. It was fine for the summer, but after I grabbed this during the Sephora sale, it was such an upgrade. I love that it’s fragrance-free, and I think the ceramides actually make it even better than before. The packaging is a nice bonus. This is one of those cases where you get what you pay for, unfortunately. If you can afford it, your dry skin will thank you! FWIW, the serum I use is a lot cheaper.

It was fine for the summer, but after I grabbed this during the Sephora sale, it was such an upgrade. review_text: I recently began using this in my night skincare regimen with all Drunk Elephant products, and have now used for 7 nights. I’ve also tried this product in the morning, and definitely recommend using at night unless you have super dry skin. My skin is combination, and has been acting up lately since I just moved from the damp PNW to dry, desert Arizona. I’ve been having lots of breakouts as my skin adjusts to the new climate. So, I was a bit nervous using this, as it is very thick and rich. To my happy surprise, I’ve had no breakouts at all since I started using. My new night routine is mixing one pump of Lala Retro with 1 pump of TLC Framboos, and my skin feels and looks great.  A little goes a long way, so I really don’t even need a full pump.  It does take a bit to absorb, so it sits on my face for a few minutes. That took some getting used to, and is another reason I recommend as a night cream only, since it would require a running start ahead of daytime makeup application.  I also want to add- I love the packaging!  You push down to pump, and the measured amount comes out of the top.  Cool!

review_text: Over 40 and a big fan of this line, esp. the orig formulation, which my skin (at times sensitive/dry) loves.  I like that it doesnt have strong scents--i work in a scent-free environ--yet no “plastic-y“  residue scent from the packaging which other ’scent-free’ formulations/brands have. Goes on great not sticky though as someone else pointed out, the amount of product is sacrificed by the dispensation/pump system. Those who like not having to dip your fingers (and contaminate said product, guessing how much u need) in will find this amazing, esp in these dry Canadian winters! If u stick to the 1 pump for your face, it lasts a pretty good length of time. Pricepoint wise, it fits my criteria of “a dollar a day“. Will i use this product everyday for __$ ? Yes i will. Bonus the packaging is recyclable. Holy grail (top 5) according to my 22 y.o who has combo-skin and uses this too after our holiday gifting/#selfcare splurge.

review_text: Let me start off by saying I LOVE this moisturizer!! I think Protini has my heart just because I’ve been using that one a while, but this is really giving it a run for its money!! I’ll do a bit of a comparison then go into further detail on Lala Retro on its own. Protini feels more like lotion consistency - a little more airy/less dense, goes on so smoothly onto your skin, and makes your skin feel a little more plump. Lala Retro in comparison feels thicker and denser, still goes on smoothly onto your skin but I feel the desire to rub it in a little more, and it makes your skin feel HYDRATED. It’s good stuff. I’m really liking it right now in the winter. I’m loving the way it’s making my skin feel - it feels like it was thirsty for some hydration and then Lala Retro gave it what it needed. I’m super happy with it. It’s the same type of packaging and size as Protini, for reference. This stuff is good y’all!! I feel like I’ll switch back and forth between the two moving forward or I might even mix the two. You won’t regret trying this out! Highly recommend.

review_text: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I have oily -  but this is so light weight - truly like whipped cream in its consistency with a gel like undertone- that it absorbs beautifully leaving my skin supple, soft and moisturized without leaving a film or sheen. It is really not thick at all as some people are saying. I add a few drops of marula oil for after i use the sukari babyfacial and after my hydration serums and essences in order to lock in the moisture. Marula is a dry oil so again despite my oily skin, I can use it without breaking out.  You see best results with this using it on properly exfoliated and hydrated skin. You cant just slap this on after washing the face. You have to hydrate and moisturize in layers and wait for each step to absorb before adding this as a final step in you skincare routine. Because i have oily skin, I dont need to use this during the day. I use it at night and I actually wake up without the usual film of oil on my skin.

review_text: I used this product all winter, and all winter I suffered from dry, flaky skin. Now, granted, I did start using tretinoin in the fall, so I know that has contributed to the dryness. However, this product really didn’t do anything to ease that dryness either, which is surprising to me. This moisturizer has oils and ceramides in it, which are great moisturizing ingredients; yet, it doesn’t even last through the night on my skin. I wake up in the morning with my skin feeling dry and tight. For a long time I refused to believe this moisturizer was playing a role in the state of my skin, but when I switched to a different one, my skin started to look and feel better. If your skin is normal, or if you’re not using any actives, this product might be fine to use. For me, though, who’s looking for some actual repair and moisture, this just doesn’t do anything.

review_text: I wanted to love this, because I was drawn to the ingredients like green tea seed extract, ceramides, hyaluronic acid, etc. I used it for three days with no problem, then I broke out badly. It’s rare for me to break out from skincare products, so I’m left wondering what components in there caused it. Nevertheless, I had to return it because it was unusable for me. When I was using it during those few days, I noticed softer, more hydrated skin, as well as a dewy luminosity that I really loved. The packaging is amazing, the texture was nice but not very spreadable (no silicones) so it took some work to get it to spread around my face. I am disappointed that it didn’t work for me because I did feel like it was a nice formula with some great ingredients.

review_text: I really really enjoyed this product! Unfortunately, my time of testing came right after vacation and so I was mending breakouts from gluten and sunscreen - as I have VERY sensitive skin. I cannot speak on whether it causes acne - but I feel as I can say that for me personally, for my very sensitive skin, it didn’t seem to speed up the healing of inflammatory acne. Because of this, I stopped using until I can test with how my skin is normally. I saved some to keep using once my breakouts subside to see if it would cause a re-emergence of breakouts or not. Other than that, I really enjoyed the texture! During this Minnesota winter, I felt the need to still add a heavy moisturizer on top (after I let it sit a few minutes), however I am interested to see if I can wear this alone during the warmer, more humid months. Over all, I enjoy it, and I would definitely consider purchasing in the future!(I received these products complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.)

review_text: This moisturizer...confuses me. It does not claim to be oil free, non-comedogenic, or dermatologist tested which are the very first things I look for in any category of skincare before I ever even consider putting something on my face. When I looked at the ingredient list, I found it does contain Passion flower seed oil, which upon my research has a fairly low likelihood of clogging pores. HOWEVER this product also contains olive oil which is a pore clogging oil, so all of my acne prone babes beware. I also have to point out that this product claims to contain probiotics (live bacteria) however this product contains preservatives like tocopherol acetate (a vitamin E derivative). What you need to understand is that preservatives kill live bacteria rendering the “probiotics” useless. Which leaves me very confused as to what this product is trying to accomplish. I do enjoy the cooling sensation of this product it’s quite nice and I find that it lasts for a decent amount of time. You may enjoy this product if you aren’t sensitive or acne prone and prefer natural skincare ingredients. But please remember that although ingredients are “natural” or vegan they can still be pore clogging and cause acne. I received this as a complimentary product.

I do enjoy the cooling sensation of this product it’s quite nice and I find that it lasts for a decent amount of time. You may enjoy this product if you aren’t sensitive or acne prone and prefer natural skincare ingredients. But please remember that although ingredients are “natural” or vegan they can still be pore clogging and cause acne. I received this as a complimentary product.

Those looking for deep hydration should look elsewhere, but for daily moisturizing, this does a good job. It has a fragrance, but it’s very light. It’s a nice step after morning cleanser and under makeup.

full_text: Great moisturizer for any skin type.. I thought this was going to be way too heavy and make me break out, I have dry - combo skin, my face is dry but my forehead and chin get oily and break out in this adult hormonal acne rage. But I gave it a go since I got it for free to try from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I found that it applies so nice when you have some moisture on your skin like a serum or your toner that way it smoothes on the skin easier. It smells nice, but not strong. I really like it, wish I had a bigger jar! Definitely will keep an eye out for a sale somewhere.

review_text: Estée Lauder’s new Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Cream is love at first use for me in the new year. Immediately nourishing, this has ingredients my skin enjoys, such as Moringa Plant Extract. I could actually see a change within the first week. It leaves behind a soft, satiny, hydrated feel. My skin looks balanced and now my makeup foundation glides across my face. Best of all, I don’t get to mid-day sensing that I need a top up of anything further. I really believe a quality moisturizer should give you the satisfaction of feeling that you are using a product which is simple and effective. I was kindly gifted this product and I’ve used it as my daytime moisturizer every day since…and now I purchased a jar myself because it’s that good!

review_text: I received a free sample of this product in exchange for my honest review. I don’t have anything bad to say about this product. It moisturizes, it absorbs just fine. The scent is mild. But it didn’t seem any different than any other nice, basic moisturizer. My skin was fine with it but I didn’t notice any changes for the better--no extra glow or softness, no blurring of fine lines, just...fine. I do think that what works just ok for one person might be a holy grail for another, and the ingredient list on this is quite good, so if you like a light but nourishing moisturizer, you will definitely get that. And maybe you will find your new favorite product.

full_text: This one was fine but definitely not my new fave. I received a free sample of this product in exchange for my honest review. I don’t have anything bad to say about this product. It moisturizes, it absorbs just fine. The scent is mild. But it didn’t seem any different than any other nice, basic moisturizer. My skin was fine with it but I didn’t notice any changes for the better--no extra glow or softness, no blurring of fine lines, just...fine. I do think that what works just ok for one person might be a holy grail for another, and the ingredient list on this is quite good, so if you like a light but nourishing moisturizer, you will definitely get that. And maybe you will find your new favorite product.

review_text: It’s nice for my extremely oily skin. The texture is interesting, it’s almost a hybrid of a gel cream but very rich feeling. It does not leave my skin oily feeling or that gross thick your skin can’t breathe feeling like the DE lalaretro gives me. I really love the advanced recovery serum, I’d say this does feel like a thick cream gel version of the serum. Skin felt plump and it sunk into skin great. Wore it under makeup without any issues of pilling. The biggest downside for me is the fragrance. It’s definitely strong. I am extremely reactive to scents , this one I can handle, didn’t get a migraine. But I really just wished they didn’t add the fragrance at all. I didn’t see any improvement in fine lines or texture yet, but I only got a mini trial to test for review , so like any skincare I’m sure it takes time to see such results. But it didn’t break me out, didn’t make my skin extremely oily. I love the texture the most.

review_text: I really enjoyed this moisturizer which kinda actually surprised me cause I usually am not too fond of gel moisturizers (don’t get me wrong their are some that just blow my mind but it’s rare) however this is probably one of the thickest gel moisturizers I have ever used and for my preference that is a good thing. It definitely gave great hydration however as far as blurring pores I didn’t really notice much of that… but I have abnormally large pores and honestly have yet to find a moisturizer that doesn’t contain dimethicone (which I like but a lot of people try to avoid) that does actually noticeably blur out my pores. Something I did however notice was my face feels very fresh and clean when using this moisturizer which I think is from the gentle exfoliation that was going on from the salicylic acid.  I also enjoyed the very light scent that this moisturizer has. Overall I think this is a great moisturizer and who knows maybe with more use I may actually see my pores look more diminished.

I also enjoyed the very light scent that this moisturizer has. Overall I think this is a great moisturizer and who knows maybe with more use I may actually see my pores look more diminished.

I’m not sure that it is worth $36.00 for a Normal size of it.

review_text: I received this in a voxbox from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and I have to say I’m pleasantly surprised. I have been using this for about 1 week now and it may become my new go-to product if it keeps working as it is supposed to. The first 2-3 days of using, I noticed a little more break outs in specific areas, but after that, my skin has been getting significantly better. Fingers crossed it will stay that way. I have very sensitive skin. Anyone that has to deal with oily, sensitive skin that is prone for breakouts knows how hard it is to find a product that actually works and does not cause more problems. The cream smells fantastic although it only has slight scent. Which is great if you want to use it with other products. It leaves a very lightweight feel and , and doesn’t make my skin feel heavy or oily throughout the rest of the day. Even when I used it combined with a liquid make up. I’ve struggled with breakouts and sensitivity my entire life and this has helped to minimize pores while keeping my skin hydrated. You can use it to target specific areas where pores appear to be larger or prone for breakouts. Or use as instructed on the product container/tube all over. I like that it incoporates natural products. The packaging is also so appealing!  Korres knocks it out of the park again. I would consider buying it in the future  and can recommend it if you have oily or sensitive skin like me.
